  • Какие workflows стоит вынести в skills?
  • Какие задачи read-heavy и подходят для subagents?
  • Где нужна память, а где достаточно checked-in docs?
  • Какие verification commands считаются обязательными?

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
Спроектируй AI-native operating model для проекта "{project}".

Верни:
- повторяемые workflows;
- какие из них оформить как skills;
- какие роли агентов нужны;
- какие правила положить в AGENTS.md;
- какие memory boundaries нужны;
- какие проверки доказывают качество.

docs.title: Playbook: build full feature with agents
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: How OpenAI uses Codex, Codex workflows, Codex best practices, A practical guide to building agents.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Провести feature от идеи до PR с управляемыми агентными ролями и проверками.

docs.title: Procedure
docs.text:
1. Создать REQUIREMENTS.md.
  2. Попросить Codex подготовить PLAN.md, не меняя код.
  3. Разделить work по ownership: backend, frontend, tests, docs, release.
  4. Запустить builder tasks в отдельных worktrees или с непересекающимися write scopes.
  5. Запустить test/review agents.
  6. Запустить evals или visual/manual QA.
  7. Подготовить PR body и release notes.
  8. Перенести повторяемый метод в skill или AGENTS.md.

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
Build this feature as a product-agent workflow.

Read:
- AGENTS.md
- REQUIREMENTS.md

Before changing files:
- produce PLAN.md;
- name ownership boundaries;
- identify required tests and evals;
- list risks and rollback.

During implementation:
- make one focused slice at a time;
- run verification after each meaningful slice;
- update RUNLOG.md.

Final output:
- changed files;
- commands run;
- test/eval result;
- PR summary;
- release notes draft;
- lessons for AGENTS.md or skills.

docs.title: Acceptance criteria
docs.text:
• Requirements, plan, tests and run log are explicit.
  • No agent edits outside its ownership without approval.
  • PR summary includes verification evidence.
  • Reusable lessons are captured.

docs.title: Playbook: code review через Codex
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex workflows, Codex subagents, Agent approvals and security.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Использовать Codex как reviewer, который ищет bugs, regressions, test gaps, security risks и maintainability issues.

docs.title: Prompt для одного агента
docs.text:
Review current changes as a code reviewer.

Prioritize:
1. Bugs and behavioral regressions.
2. Security or data-safety risks.
3. Missing tests for changed behavior.
4. Maintainability issues only if they affect correctness.

Output findings first.
Each finding must include file, line, severity, and why it matters.
Do not rewrite code unless asked.

docs.title: Parallel review
docs.text:
Для больших PR можно явно попросить subagents:

Use one parallel subagent per review track:
- Security risks
- Correctness bugs
- Test gaps
- Maintainability

Wait for all agents and return a consolidated review.
Do not include duplicate findings.

docs.title: Verification
docs.text:
• Проверить, что findings ссылаются на реальные файлы и строки.
  • Запросить reproduction или failing test для каждого high-severity bug.
  • Не принимать stylistic comments как blockers без behavioral risk.

docs.title: Playbook: Context7 deep research
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Context7 results for OpenAI docs, Source registry.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Использовать Context7 как быстрый retrieval layer для расширения базы знаний, но сохранять official-source discipline.

docs.title: Процедура
docs.text:
1. Сформулировать research question как список capabilities, а не как общий запрос.
  2. Resolve library ID для каждой библиотеки.
  3. Query docs не более чем по трем самым важным направлениям за один проход.
  4. Разделить результаты на:
  5. official facts;
  6. examples/recipes;
  7. architecture implications;
  8. claims that need direct source verification.
  9. Добавить или обновить source cards.
  10. Внести изменения в docs.
  11. Запустить проверки.

docs.title: Хороший запрос
docs.text:
Extract authoritative design details for the OpenAI Agents SDK:
Agent, Runner, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, tracing,
context, multi-agent orchestration, and recommended architecture patterns.
Focus on concepts useful for documenting multi-agent systems with memory.

docs.title: Плохой запрос
docs.text:
Tell me everything about agents.

Он слишком широкий: результат будет трудно проверить и перенести в source registry.

docs.title: Output contract
docs.text:
context7_libraries:
  - library_id: ""
    source_reputation: "High | Medium | Low"
findings:
  - claim: ""
    source_url: ""
    target_doc: ""
    action: "add | update | reject | verify_directly"
risks:
  - ""
verification:
  - "python tools/check_docs.py"
  - "python -m mkdocs build --strict"

docs.title: Playbook: обновление документации
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex changelog, Codex workflows.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Поддерживать базу знаний актуальной при изменениях Codex, Agents SDK и связанных workflows.

docs.title: Trigger
docs.text:
• Новая запись в Codex changelog.
  • Изменение официальной страницы.
  • Новый verified insight.
  • Пользователь просит обновить раздел.

docs.title: Procedure
docs.text:
1. Откройте docs/sources/registry.md.
  2. Найдите source cards, связанные с темой.
  3. Сверьте официальные страницы.
  4. Обновите checked_at.
  5. Измените только затронутые разделы.
  6. Если появляется новая спорная практика, добавьте insight card, а не основную инструкцию.
  7. Запустите:
python tools/check_docs.py
python -m mkdocs build --strict

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
Обнови раздел "{section}" по официальным источникам.

Constraints:
- Official docs are source of truth.
- Update source registry checked_at values for touched sources.
- Put community claims into docs/insights/.
- Keep Russian prose and English OpenAI terms.

Verification:
- Run python tools/check_docs.py.
- Run python -m mkdocs build --strict.

docs.title: Output
docs.text:
Итоговый отчет должен содержать:

  • измененные файлы;
  • источники;
  • что устарело;
  • что добавлено;
  • команды проверки и их результат.

docs.title: Playbook: eval-driven improvement loop
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Iterate on difficult problems, Model optimization, OpenAI Cookbook, Responses API.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Решать hard tasks через scored improvement loop, а не через одноразовый prompt.

docs.title: Loop
docs.text:
1. Run baseline eval.
  2. Identify the biggest failure mode.
  3. Make one focused change.
  4. Re-run eval.
  5. Inspect generated artifacts.
  6. Log scores and decision.
  7. Continue until deterministic score and LLM-judge average meet thresholds.

docs.title: Eval matrix
docs.text: Check type Что проверяет Пример Deterministic Формальные constraints tests pass, lint, broken links, schema LLM-as-judge Subjective quality usefulness, readability, visual quality Artifact inspection Реальный output screenshot, report, generated page Regression Старые сценарии no previous pass regressed

docs.title: Stopping rule
docs.text:
overall_score_min: 0.90
llm_judge_average_min: 0.90
no_blocking_regressions: true
artifact_review_required: true

docs.title: RUNLOG rule
docs.text:
Каждая итерация должна записывать:

  • baseline or previous best;
  • change made;
  • score before/after;
  • artifact inspected;
  • bottleneck;
  • next attempt.

docs.title: Playbook: grounded answering
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Prompting, Structured Outputs, Model optimization, OpenAI Cookbook.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Дать ответ GPT-моделью с минимальным риском hallucinations: retrieve, constrain, answer, cite, verify, escalate uncertainty.

docs.title: Procedure
docs.text:
1. Определите тип вопроса: factual, design, coding, current data, opinion.
  2. Соберите context из разрешенных источников.
  3. Упакуйте context с source IDs.
  4. Сформулируйте prompt contract.
  5. Потребуйте citations или structured output.
  6. Пропустите ответ через verifier.
  7. Если context недостаточен, верните missing context вместо догадки.

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
# Role
You are a grounded answer generator.

# Goal
Answer the user question using only the provided sources.

# Context
<source id="S1" type="official" url="...">
...
</source>

# Rules
- Every factual claim must cite a source ID.
- If a claim is not supported, put it in unsupported_claims.
- If sources conflict, describe the conflict.
- If context is insufficient, do not guess.

# Output
Return:
- answer
- citations
- assumptions
- unsupported_claims
- missing_context
- confidence: high | medium | low

docs.title: Verifier prompt
docs.text:
Check the answer against the provided sources.

For each factual claim:
- supported
- unsupported
- contradicted
- needs_fresh_check

Return verdict: pass | fail | needs_more_context.

docs.title: Acceptance criteria
docs.text:
• Нет factual claims без citation.
  • Нет invented source IDs.
  • Missing context явно назван.
  • Если confidence ниже high, ответ объясняет почему.
  • Для текущих фактов выполнена fresh verification или указана невозможность проверки.

docs.title: Playbook: maintain agent operating docs
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: AGENTS.md docs, Codex best practices, AGENTS.md open format.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Поддерживать AGENTS.md, skills, playbooks и templates как живую операционную систему проекта.

docs.title: Update triggers
docs.text:
• Agent repeatedly asks the same clarification.
  • Test command changed.
  • Workflow repeated three or more times.
  • New failure mode appears in review.
  • Automation failed due to missing setup.
  • Team adds new package, service, or deployment path.

docs.title: Maintenance loop
docs.text:
1. Collect recurring friction from RUNLOG and review notes.
  2. Decide destination:
  3. always-on rule -> AGENTS.md;
  4. task method -> skill;
  5. one-off lesson -> insight;
  6. source-backed fact -> source registry and docs.
  7. Keep instructions short and scoped.
  8. Run docs checks.
  9. Verify a sample Codex prompt can follow the updated instructions.

docs.title: Anti-patterns
docs.text:
• Put every possible rule into root AGENTS.md.
  • Hide task-specific workflows in persistent instructions.
  • Create broad skills that overlap.
  • Automate before manual workflow is stable.
  • Keep run logs only in chat history.

docs.title: Playbook: product-ready PR with Codex
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: How OpenAI uses Codex, Codex GitHub integration, Codex best practices.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Подготовить PR, который reviewer может оценить без повторного расследования.

docs.title: PR packet
docs.text:
## Summary
- What changed
- Why it changed
- Product/user impact

## Verification
- Command:
- Result:
- Manual/visual QA:
- Evals:

## Risks
- ...

## Rollback
- ...

## Agent notes
- Sources:
- Assumptions:
- Follow-ups:

docs.title: Review gates
docs.text:
• Tests and evals run after final diff.
  • No unresolved unsupported claims.
  • No broad permissions hidden in automation.
  • Risky behavior has rollback note.
  • Release notes are written if user-facing behavior changes.

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
Prepare this branch for a product-ready PR.

Read AGENTS.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, PLAN.md, TEST.md and RUNLOG.md.
Return:
- PR title;
- PR body;
- verification evidence;
- risks and rollback;
- release notes draft.
Do not claim tests pass unless you ran them in this turn.

docs.title: Playbook: multi-agent research loop
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex subagents, Codex workflows, Agent Skills.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Создать управляемый research loop для обновления базы знаний: поиск источников, отделение официальных фактов от community signals, проверка claims и выпуск документационного изменения.

docs.title: Когда использовать
docs.text:
• Появился новый Codex changelog entry.
  • Нужно добавить раздел по новой возможности.
  • Есть community trick, который может быть полезен, но требует проверки.

docs.title: Single-agent режим
docs.text:
Исследуй тему "{topic}" для базы знаний Codex.

Сделай:
1. Найди официальные источники OpenAI.
2. Составь source cards.
3. Отдели community claims от official claims.
4. Предложи изменения в docs.
5. Укажи verification commands.
Не смешивай неподтвержденные tricks с официальными инструкциями.

docs.title: Parallel режим
docs.text:
Используйте только когда явно хотите subagents:

Use parallel subagents for this research task.

Agent 1: official Codex docs.
Agent 2: Agents SDK docs for memory/orchestration.
Agent 3: community insight backlog.

Each agent returns verified claims, uncertain claims, and source cards.
Wait for all agents. Then synthesize one update plan and do not include raw logs.

docs.title: Acceptance criteria
docs.text:
• Новые official claims имеют source cards.
  • Community claims лежат только в docs/insights/.
  • Каждый proposed edit имеет verification status.
  • MkDocs build проходит.

docs.title: Context7 enrichment
docs.text: Когда тема связана с OpenAI SDK, Responses API, Codex или Agents SDK, добавьте отдельный проход по Context7 deep research. Его цель - найти SDK-level details: primitives, method contracts, tool types, structured output examples и observability patterns. После retrieval все равно обновляйте source registry, а не вставляйте неподписанные claims напрямую.

docs.title: Playbook: use case to plugin
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex use cases, Save workflows as skills, Create a CLI Codex can use, Codex plugins, Build plugins.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Превратить официальный Codex use case или повторяемый workflow команды в plugin, который можно применять в реальных проектах: с узкими skills, понятными inputs/outputs, безопасной политикой записи, проверками, eval cases и документированным lifecycle.

docs.title: Когда использовать
docs.text:
• Вы нашли официальный use case, который часто повторяется в проектах.
  • У вас уже есть удачный Codex thread, runbook, PR, Slack thread, checklist или script.
  • Workflow требует нескольких capabilities: skills, CLI, MCP, GitHub, Slack, Figma, Playwright, Sentry, Spreadsheet, Documents, Computer Use.
  • Команда хочет не длинный prompt, а переносимый plugin.

docs.title: Step 1: выберите archetype
docs.text:
Сначала классифицируйте workflow по официальной таксономии.

official_archetype: "Build responsive front-end designs"
category: "Front-end"
team: "Design / Engineering"
task_type: "Design"
runtime_surface: "Codex App + Playwright skill"
time_horizon: "1h"

Если прямого use case нет, выберите ближайший:

  • analysis workflow -> Understand large codebases, Learn a new concept, Analyze datasets.
  • code workflow -> Refactor codebase, Run code migrations, Create CLI.
  • testing workflow -> Add evals, QA with Computer Use, iOS simulator debugging.
  • workflow automation -> Bug triage, Verified operations, Set up teammate.
  • design/product workflow -> Figma to code, PRD drafts, user stories to UI mocks.

docs.title: Step 2: извлеките workflow contract
docs.text:
Заполните короткую карту.

Поле Вопрос Outcome Что пользователь получает в конце? Inputs Какие источники нужны? Read-only phase Что агент обязан проверить до правок? Allowed changes Что можно менять? Forbidden actions Что нельзя делать без approval? Skills/tools Какие skills, plugins, MCP или CLI нужны? Verification Какие команды, screenshots, evals, logs или review checks доказывают результат? Output format Как агент должен завершить работу?

docs.title: Step 3: запишите manual playbook
docs.text:
Не начинайте со skill. Сначала опишите ручной маршрут.

Goal:
Inputs:
Official archetype:
Constraints:
Read-only inventory:
Smallest useful plan:
Implementation or staged draft:
Verification:
Evidence:
Risks:
Next action:

В этом состоянии workflow можно запустить обычным Codex prompt. Цель - получить один удачный runlog.

docs.title: Step 4: создайте source-backed prompt packet
docs.text:
Prompt packet должен ссылаться на официальный use case и локальные правила.

Use the workflow pattern from: <official use case URL>.

Task:
<specific job>

Before editing:
- Read AGENTS.md and the target files/sources.
- Inventory inputs and name missing access.
- Propose the smallest useful plan.

Constraints:
- Keep the first pass focused.
- Do not change source-of-truth systems.
- Separate evidence from guesses.
- Stop if required credentials or approvals are missing.

Verification:
- Run <command/check/eval>.
- Capture <screenshots/logs/artifacts>.

Return:
- Files changed or staged artifacts.
- Checks run.
- Evidence.
- Risks and open questions.
- Recommended next step.

docs.title: Step 5: решите, нужен ли CLI
docs.text:
Создавайте CLI, если агенту нужны:

  • paged search;
  • exact reads by ID;
  • predictable JSON;
  • downloads from a service;
  • local indexing;
  • draft-before-write commands;
  • reusable operation around logs, exports, databases or internal APIs.

CLI не нужен, если достаточно прочитать локальные файлы или один раз вызвать существующий script.

docs.title: Step 6: создайте skill
docs.text:
Skill должен делать одну работу. Не упаковывайте весь product lifecycle в один skill.

Минимальный состав:

  • SKILL.md с trigger, scope, workflow, verification, failure modes.
  • references/ только для длинных runbooks или style guides.
  • scripts/ только для deterministic commands.
  • assets/ для templates, fixtures, examples.

Проверка skill:

Test Ожидание Should trigger Skill вызывается на правильный prompt. Should not trigger Skill не перехватывает соседние задачи. Missing input Skill просит только блокирующий input. Unsafe write Skill останавливается или создает draft. Verification failure Skill сообщает failure evidence и next action.

docs.title: Step 7: упакуйте plugin
docs.text:
Plugin нужен, когда workflow больше одного skill или требует shared distribution.

Plugin blueprint должен включать:

  • target users and teams;
  • official archetypes;
  • included skills;
  • MCP servers or app integrations;
  • CLI commands;
  • model/reasoning policy;
  • permissions and write policy;
  • eval cases;
  • packaging/update process;
  • owner and maintenance cadence.

Используйте шаблон: Plugin blueprint.

docs.title: Step 8: добавьте eval loop
docs.text:
Для plugin недостаточно "работает на моем prompt". Нужны eval cases.

Case type Пример Happy path Вход полный, workflow возвращает правильный artifact. Missing access Slack/GitHub/Figma источник недоступен, plugin называет проблему. Unsafe request Пользователь просит отправить сообщение без approval, plugin делает draft. Wrong scope Prompt просит слишком широкий backlog, plugin сужает до одной job. Verification failure Build/eval/Playwright падает, plugin возвращает evidence и не объявляет успех.

docs.title: Step 9: продвигайте только стабильное
docs.text:
Promotion path:

flowchart LR
    A["Successful manual thread"] --> B["Playbook"]
    B --> C["Skill"]
    C --> D["Failure log"]
    D --> E["Refined skill"]
    E --> F["Plugin"]
    F --> G["Fixture evals"]
    G --> H["Team rollout"]
    H --> I["Automation candidate"]

Automation появляется только после того, как plugin стабильно работает вручную и имеет понятный audit artifact.

docs.title: Review checklist
docs.text:
• Есть официальный source или статус experiment.
  • Есть один ясный job.
  • Inputs и outputs зафиксированы.
  • Read-only phase есть до edits.
  • Write policy явно указана.
  • Verification нельзя заменить словами "looks good".
  • Skill не требует приватных данных в примерах.
  • Plugin не смешивает unrelated workflows.
  • Есть failure log и update loop.
  • Есть владелец, который обновляет sources и eval cases.

docs.title: Playbook: workflow to skill
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Agent Skills, Codex best practices, Codex automations.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text:
Превратить повторяемый workflow в Codex skill, который можно использовать вручную, затем тестировать и при необходимости автоматизировать.

Если workflow должен стать plugin, используйте Playbook: use case to plugin после того, как первый skill прошел реальную проверку.

docs.title: Когда workflow готов к skill
docs.text:
• Выполнялся вручную минимум несколько раз.
  • Inputs и outputs стабильны.
  • Есть понятный trigger.
  • Есть verification command или checklist.
  • Риски и forbidden actions известны.

docs.title: Skill rubric
docs.text: Критерий Требование Scope Один job, не "делай все" Trigger Описание содержит явные trigger words Inputs Перечислены required inputs Outputs Формат результата фиксирован Progressive disclosure SKILL.md краткий, references по необходимости Scripts Только для deterministic behavior или external tooling Evals Есть cases: should trigger, should not trigger

docs.title: Lifecycle
docs.text:
flowchart LR
    M["Manual workflow"] --> D["Draft skill"]
    D --> T["Trigger tests"]
    T --> U["Use in real tasks"]
    U --> F["Failure log"]
    F --> R["Refine"]
    R --> P["Package as plugin"]
    P --> A["Automation candidate"]

docs.title: Candidate product skills
docs.text:
• product-spec-writer
  • implementation-planner
  • test-gap-finder
  • release-note-writer
  • eval-loop-runner
  • ui-visual-reviewer
  • workspace-readiness-auditor

docs.title: Playbook: workspace readiness audit
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex best practices, AGENTS.md docs, Agent approvals and security, Codex automations.

docs.title: Цель
docs.text: Проверить, готов ли workspace к product-agent workflows.

docs.title: Audit checklist
docs.text: Area Pass condition Instructions AGENTS.md exists and names setup/test commands Source policy Official/community/experiment rules are explicit Build Build command documented Tests Test command documented Evals Subjective outputs have eval or review rubric Sandbox Approval and network rules are known Worktrees Parallel work strategy exists Skills Repeated workflows have skill candidates Automation Only stable workflows are scheduled Runtime evidence RUNLOG.md or equivalent exists for long runs

docs.title: Prompt
docs.text:
Audit this workspace for Codex product-agent readiness.

Do not edit files.
Check:
- AGENTS.md;
- setup/build/test commands;
- evals;
- skills candidates;
- automation candidates;
- sandbox/approval risks;
- missing control-plane files.

Return:
- readiness score 0-100;
- blockers;
- recommended docs or skill additions;
- first workflow to automate.

docs.title: Control-plane files
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex best practices, AGENTS.md docs, AGENTS.md open format, Iterate on difficult problems.

docs.title: Почему нужны control-plane files
docs.text: Длинная сессия не должна быть единственным местом, где живут требования и решения. Control-plane files делают работу resumable, reviewable и пригодной для skills/automations.

docs.title: Набор файлов
docs.text: Файл Назначение Обновляется AGENTS.md Постоянные правила проекта Когда правило должно жить между задачами REQUIREMENTS.md Scope, users, acceptance criteria Перед планированием PLAN.md Decomposition, ownership, sequence До implementation TEST.md Deterministic checks, manual QA, visual QA До review EVALS.md LLM-as-judge, score thresholds, artifacts Для subjective/long-horizon задач RUNLOG.md Iterations, scores, decisions, current best Во время длинного цикла

docs.title: Что идет в AGENTS.md
docs.text:
Подходит:

  • setup commands;
  • build/test/lint commands;
  • code style;
  • security constraints;
  • architecture map;
  • PR/release rules;
  • rules that every agent run must know.

Не подходит:

  • редкие длинные справочники;
  • transient task details;
  • raw logs;
  • secrets;
  • policy that belongs in sandbox/approval config.

docs.title: Nested AGENTS.md
docs.text: Для monorepo используйте root AGENTS.md для общих правил и nested files для отдельных packages или services. Ближайшие инструкции должны уточнять, а не дублировать root policy.

docs.title: Product lifecycle
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: How OpenAI uses Codex, Codex best practices, Iterate on difficult problems, Codex workflows.

docs.title: End-to-end loop
docs.text: Stage Agent work Artifact Gate Idea Clarify user value, hypothesis, metric and constraints REQUIREMENTS.md Scope and success metric are explicit Spec Turn idea into behavior and acceptance criteria REQUIREMENTS.md User intent and source-of-truth docs are locked Plan Decompose work, architecture boundary and ownership PLAN.md Tasks are independent enough Build Implement one focused slice at a time Diff Test-first or eval-first path exists Eval Score deterministic, subjective and AI quality TEST.md, EVALS.md, reports Threshold met or gap accepted Review Find bugs, security risks, test gaps Review findings No unresolved blocker PR Prepare branch, PR body, docs impact and release notes PR / changelog Verification evidence included Learn Capture reusable method AGENTS.md, skill, insight Next run improves

docs.title: Ask Mode before Code Mode
docs.text:
OpenAI's Codex guidance recommends starting large changes with a plan before implementation. In this project, that means:

First produce PLAN.md from REQUIREMENTS.md.
Do not edit product code until the plan names:
- files or subsystems;
- acceptance criteria;
- verification commands;
- risks and rollback;
- what is out of scope.

docs.title: Work granularity
docs.text: Good Codex tasks are scoped enough that a human could complete them in a focused block. If a task spans product, design, backend, frontend, tests, docs and release at once, split it into lifecycle stages and use control-plane files as the handoff.

docs.title: Learning loop
docs.text:
Every finished product-agent workflow should answer:

  • Which instructions should move into AGENTS.md?
  • Which repeated steps deserve a skill?
  • Which check should become an automation?
  • Which failure needs an eval?
  • Which source or architecture decision should be documented?
  • Which metric or user feedback should drive the next product iteration?

docs.title: Product-Agent Workflows
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: How OpenAI uses Codex, Codex best practices, A practical guide to building agents, Agent Skills, AGENTS.md.

docs.title: Что добавляет этот слой
docs.text:
Предыдущие разделы объясняют Codex, prompts, context, memory и agents. Product-Agent Workflows соединяет их в операционную систему разработки продукта:

  • AGENTS.md задает постоянные правила репозитория;
  • control-plane files фиксируют требования, план, проверки и run log;
  • skills превращают повторяемые методы в reusable workflows;
  • subagents и Agents SDK помогают распределять bounded work;
  • eval loops и PR checks доказывают качество;
  • runtime tools запускают это в App, CLI, cloud, GitHub или automation.

docs.title: Главная идея
docs.text:
Полноценный продукт не стоит строить одним длинным prompt. Его нужно вести как управляемый delivery loop:

flowchart LR
    I["Idea"] --> S["Spec"]
    S --> P["Plan"]
    P --> B["Build"]
    B --> T["Tests and evals"]
    T --> R["Review"]
    R --> PR["PR"]
    PR --> REL["Release notes"]
    REL --> L["Lessons to AGENTS.md / skills"]

docs.title: Когда достаточно Codex, а когда нужны agents и skills
docs.text: Ситуация Достаточный уровень Разовая правка, понятный diff Codex App / CLI Повторяемая процедура Skill Фоновая регулярная проверка Automation Сложная фича с несколькими ролями Product-Agent Workflow Программируемая оркестрация Agents SDK + Codex MCP Продуктовый improvement loop Evals + RUNLOG + artifact inspection

docs.title: Product-Agent OS plugin
docs.text: Для упаковки этого operating model в переносимый Codex plugin используйте Product-Agent OS plugin. Новый раздел описывает назначение плагина, текущие capabilities, installation boundary, Codex-only runtime runner, guardrails и diagram-level принципы работы.

docs.title: Definition of ready
docs.text:
Перед запуском product-agent workflow должны быть:

  • понятная цель и non-goals;
  • выбранный runtime: App, CLI, cloud, codex exec, MCP или GitHub Action;
  • control-plane files;
  • test/eval commands;
  • ownership файлов или подсистем;
  • policy для sandbox, approvals, secrets и network;
  • критерий остановки.

docs.title: Specification: Product-Agent OS plugin
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex plugins, Build plugins, Agent Skills, Subagents, AGENTS.md, Codex hooks, Agent approvals and security, Codex with Agents SDK, Codex use cases, A practical guide to building agents.

docs.title: Назначение
docs.text:
product-agent-os - это production-ready Codex plugin, который превращает текущий workspace пользователя в управляемую среду реализации проекта через Codex App, CLI, IDE extension, subagents, skills, AGENTS.md, hooks, evals и automation candidates.

Plugin должен вести проект от идеи до production-ready результата:

flowchart LR
    A["Idea"] --> B["Discovery"]
    B --> C["Requirements"]
    C --> D["Plan"]
    D --> E["Agent team"]
    E --> F["Build slices"]
    F --> G["Tests and evals"]
    G --> H["Review"]
    H --> I["PR or release packet"]
    I --> J["Learning loop"]
    J --> K["Automation candidates"]

Главная цель plugin - не создать набор файлов один раз, а поддерживать lifecycle проекта через проверяемые артефакты, gated changes, role ownership, handoff contracts и evidence. Track 6 расширяет это до engineering standards layer: product hypothesis, architecture boundary, test-first/eval-first verification, docs-as-code, human review, release measurement и learning loop.

docs.title: Не цели
docs.text:
• Не заменять human product owner: спорные цели, рискованные approvals и irreversible actions остаются за пользователем.
  • Не менять global ~/.codex/config.toml, глобальные credentials или user-level memory без явного запроса.
  • Не запускать все skills подряд. Orchestrator выбирает маршрут по профилю проекта и текущему lifecycle state.
  • Не сохранять secrets, tokens, private customer data, raw credentials, private chat logs или PII в generated files, memory, docs, fixtures, examples или run logs.
  • Не создавать automation до ручной стабилизации workflow и появления failure log.

docs.title: Lifecycle state machine
docs.text:
project-lifecycle-orchestrator является entrypoint. Он определяет текущее состояние проекта и выбирает следующий skill.

State Trigger Required artifact Gate before next state uninitialized Plugin впервые применен к workspace PROJECT_AUDIT.md или audit section in RUNLOG.md Discovery complete, no write yet infrastructure_planned Audit completed INFRASTRUCTURE_PLAN.md or staged plan section User approves write scope requirements_ready Goal and constraints clear REQUIREMENTS.md Acceptance criteria explicit plan_ready Requirements stable PLAN.md Ownership and verification named team_ready Work needs roles or parallelism .codex/agents/*.toml Write scopes do not overlap build_active Approved implementation slice Diff + RUNLOG.md entry Slice verification run quality_gate Build slice completed TEST.md, EVALS.md, reports No blocking failure review_ready Checks pass or failures documented Review findings No unresolved blocker release_ready Review complete PR packet or release packet Verification evidence included learning_ready Delivery complete Updated RUNLOG.md, skill candidates, automation candidates Reusable lessons classified maintenance Stable recurring workflow exists Automation candidate packet Manual workflow stable

The orchestrator must never skip from uninitialized to build_active.

docs.title: Complexity profiles
docs.text:
Plugin computes a ComplexityProfile during discovery.

profile:
  name: "guided-small | standard-product | production-team | ai-product | enterprise-governed | autonomous-maintenance"
  confidence: "high | medium | low"
  drivers:
    repo_size: "small | medium | large"
    stack_count: 1
    service_count: 1
    test_maturity: "none | partial | strong"
    ci_present: true
    external_integrations: []
    risk_level: "low | medium | high"
    team_mode: "solo | team | enterprise"
    autonomy_target: "supervised | assisted | recurring"
    change_surface: "docs | code | production_ops | external_systems"
  recommended_route:
    - "workspace-discovery-auditor"
    - "requirements-author"
    - "implementation-planner"

Profile decisions:

Profile Creates Skips by default guided-small AGENTS.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, PLAN.md, TEST.md, RUNLOG.md Custom agents beyond planner/reviewer, automations standard-product Control-plane files, role cards, basic hooks, eval skeleton Enterprise rules, programmable runner production-team Worktree strategy, full agent team, strict handoff, PR packet Autonomous recurring tasks until stable ai-product Prompt/context policy, eval suite, LLM-as-judge rubric, regression logs External writes without approval enterprise-governed Strict approval policy, forbidden paths, audit evidence, staged config Global config mutation autonomous-maintenance Automation candidates, recurring run prompts, failure log New automations without manual success history

docs.title: Initialization behavior
docs.text:
After user invokes the plugin:

  1. Read AGENTS.md, README, package files, CI config, test config, .codex/, docs/, git state and current working tree status.
  2. Produce read-only WorkspaceAudit.
  3. Infer complexity profile and usage_mode.
  4. Return usage_mode.primary, secondary, confidence, route reasons, fallback, minimum artifacts, behavioral eval cases and first-response contract.
  5. Ask only blocking clarifying questions. Examples: product goal absent, destructive rewrite requested, ambiguous ownership, missing test command for production profile, or route confidence is low.
  6. Propose an InfrastructurePlan.
  7. Present staged changes with file list and write policy.
  8. Wait for explicit approval before writing.

Expected first response shape:

workspace_audit:
  status: "ready_for_plan | blocked | needs_user_input"
  detected_stack: []
  existing_control_plane: []
  missing_control_plane: []
  risks: []
complexity_profile:
  name: ""
  confidence: ""
infrastructure_plan:
  create: []
  update: []
  leave_unchanged: []
  requires_approval: []
usage_mode:
  primary: ""
  secondary: []
  confidence: ""
  minimum_artifacts: []
  behavioral_eval_cases: []
questions:
  - ""
next_action: "approve_infrastructure_plan | answer_questions | run_read_only_audit_again"

docs.title: Generated project files
docs.text: File Owner Purpose Update rule AGENTS.md Orchestrator + user approval Durable project rules Only stable rules that apply across future tasks REQUIREMENTS.md Product Manager role Goal, users, scope, non-goals, acceptance criteria When product intent changes PLAN.md Architect role Decomposition, ownership, sequence, no-placeholder plan quality, risks, rollback Before implementation and when plan changes TEST.md Tester role Deterministic checks, manual QA, visual QA Before quality gate EVALS.md Eval designer role Subjective checks, LLM-as-judge rubric, thresholds For AI, UX, docs, long-horizon or subjective outputs RUNLOG.md Orchestrator Iterations, scores, decisions, evidence, handoff summary Every meaningful lifecycle step .codex/config.toml Orchestrator + user approval Project-scoped Codex defaults Staged; never overwrite blindly .codex/agents/*.toml Agent team designer Project-scoped custom agents Generated from role cards and profile .codex/hooks/* Hook author Deterministic guardrails and evidence capture Enabled only after validation .codex/workflows/*.md Workflow builder Reusable task packets Created from stable routes .codex/evals/*.json Eval designer Fixture evals and expected behaviors Updated from failure log

docs.title: System file update policy
docs.text:
Plugin updates system files through merge-safe sections.

Generated sections use stable markers:

<!-- product-agent-os:start <section-id> -->
...
<!-- product-agent-os:end <section-id> -->

Rules:

  • User-authored content outside managed sections is preserved.
  • Existing managed sections are updated only after a new plan is shown.
  • If a file exists without markers, plugin proposes an append or separate companion file.
  • If merge is ambiguous, plugin stops and returns a conflict report.
  • Source-backed claims require official source or experiment label.

docs.title: Context and information overflow policy
docs.text:
Plugin uses layered context.

Layer Contents Loaded when Hot AGENTS.md, active REQUIREMENTS.md, active PLAN.md, current task packet Every lifecycle step Warm TEST.md, EVALS.md, latest RUNLOG.md summary, active role cards Planning, build, review, eval Cold Archived runlogs, historical eval reports, old decisions, source cards Only when referenced External Official docs, Context7, MCP sources When freshness or library detail matters

Compaction rules:

  • RUNLOG.md keeps current best, latest iterations and handoff summary.
  • Older iterations move to docs/runlogs/archive/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md or .codex/runlogs/archive/ depending on project convention.
  • Raw subagent logs are summarized into evidence, decisions and risks.
  • AGENTS.md stays concise; long guidance moves to docs or .codex/workflows/.
  • Skill bodies stay short; long details live in references/.
  • Memory is never used as citation source; important facts are retrieved or read from checked-in docs.

docs.title: Skills
docs.text:
Skill Job Required inputs Output Verification project-lifecycle-orchestrator Route the lifecycle and enforce gates User goal, workspace audit, current state Next action packet State transition is valid workspace-discovery-auditor Read-only project audit Workspace path WorkspaceAudit No writes; detected files exist requirements-author Create/update requirements Goal, users, constraints REQUIREMENTS.md Acceptance criteria present implementation-planner Produce executable plan Requirements, audit PLAN.md Ownership, tests, rollback named agent-team-designer Generate roles and custom agents Plan, complexity profile .codex/agents/*.toml TOML validates test-eval-designer Define tests and evals Requirements, plan, stack TEST.md, EVALS.md Thresholds and artifacts explicit risk-reviewer Review diff and project risk Diff, plan, tests Findings by severity No unsupported claims pr-release-operator Prepare PR/release packet Diff, checks, runlog PR body, release notes, rollback Evidence included learning-loop-maintainer Capture reusable lessons Final result, failures AGENTS.md suggestions, skill candidates Lessons classified automation-promoter Propose recurring runs Stable workflow, failure log Automation candidate packet Manual success history exists

Each skill must define trigger, boundaries, inputs, outputs, failure modes and final response contract.

Track 3 workflow templates cover task-packet jobs that are not packaged as SKILL.md bundles in the current implementation:

  • source-context-pack.md covers official-source and Context7 research packets.
  • worktree-ownership.md covers parallel ownership and worktree maps.
  • build-slice.md covers one approved implementation slice with verification evidence.
  • development-standards.md covers product hypothesis, architecture boundary, test-first/eval-first verification, bounded agent implementation, review and release measurement.
  • documentation-system.md covers docs-as-code source-of-truth artifacts for architecture, API, UI, code reference, database and release docs.

Track 7 artifact templates cover methodology outputs that are too concrete to leave as prose-only workflow advice:

  • adr.md for architecture decision records with context, decision, consequences, verification and rollback.
  • architecture-overview.md for C4-style system/container notes, quality attributes and architecture risks.
  • domain-modeling.md for bounded context, ubiquitous language traceability, aggregates, invariants, domain events, context maps and bounded-context-to-architecture traceability.
  • metric-spec.md for product hypothesis, baseline, North Star or primary value metric, input metric, counter-metric, guardrail metrics, proxy metric risk, privacy classification, retention period, data minimization, owner signoff, Goodhart checks and post-release review.
  • api-contract-review.md for OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, auth, errors, examples, compatibility and generated docs checks.
  • component-card.md for UI states, accessibility, public API and Storybook documentation.
  • database-dictionary.md for table meaning, sensitive fields, retention, migration history and schema verification.

Track 8 completed workflow templates cover scenario-specific first actions:

  • first-run-intake.md keeps first launch small for empty, broken, existing control-plane and complex system starts: mode, confidence, next smallest action, minimum artifacts, approval boundary and evidence gaps.
  • bug-rescue.md and bug-rescue-report.md enforce reproduction and root-cause evidence before fixes.
  • greenfield-idea-to-plan.md and greenfield-idea-brief.md block scaffold before selected direction and approval.
  • complex-system-acceleration.md and integration-catalog.md force ownership split, release gates and integration risk mapping before parallel work.
  • pr-review-readiness.md and pr-risk-review.md provide read-only changed-file review with spec compliance before quality/risk verdict.
  • review-slice.md, RUNLOG.md, pr-risk-review.md and risk-reviewer generalize that two-stage review to risky public-contract, migration, security-sensitive, data migration, release packaging and parallel slices.
  • agent-team-designer, handoff-contract.md, agent-task-packet.md and worktree-ownership.md require fresh-context handoff before subagent or parallel worker execution.
  • acceptance-scenarios.md, generated REQUIREMENTS/TEST/EVALS, development-standards.md, requirements-author, implementation-planner, test-eval-designer, project-readiness.json and behavioral-workflows.json require ATDD/BDD traceability before behavior changes: requirement -> scenario -> check -> evidence owner, Given/When/Then or equivalent behavior format, business rule, edge case, non-goal, explicit gap and evidence owner.
  • domain-modeling.md, architecture-overview.md, project-readiness.json, discovery.py, implementation-planner and fixture eval require conditional DDD domain modeling for complex backend/workflow/enterprise/data-heavy/multi-service/multi-context work, plus bounded_context_architecture_boundary_trace from every bounded context to an architecture boundary or accepted gap and ubiquitous_language_traceability from each domain term to requirement/source plus API/event/contract, UI label, code module or owner; simple CRUD or simple MVP work can mark DDD as not applicable or accepted gap.
  • component-card.md, development-standards.md, project-readiness.json, discovery.py, workspace-discovery-auditor and implementation-planner support optional fsd_structure for applicable web UI/component work; backend, native, simple CRUD and simple MVP work can mark Feature-Sliced Design as not applicable or accepted gap.
  • metric-spec.md, release-packet.md, generated REQUIREMENTS/PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, project-readiness.json, lifecycle skills and fixture eval require metric_hardening_when_product_behavior_changes for product behavior changes; product success claims need counter-metric, guardrail, qualitative review and post-release review evidence, not a single proxy metric.
  • docs-tooling-decision.md, documentation-system.md, generated PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, project-readiness.json, lifecycle skills, discovery.py and fixture eval require docs_tooling_selector and docs_as_code_impact statuses for stack-aware docs tooling without forced installs or unapproved external activation.
  • project-readiness.json, generated AGENTS/PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, lifecycle skills and fixture eval require conditional readiness gates with readiness_statuses, applicability, required evidence, owner and residual risk; detection alone can only support present_unverified.
  • legacy-onboarding.md and onboarding-map.md keep old or undocumented repos in read-only orientation with present_unverified claims before refactor.
  • api-migration.md and migration-plan.md route HTTP API and event contract changes through OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, consumers, generated clients, backwards compatibility, deprecation, rollout, release impact and owner review gates before implementation or release.
  • ai-eval-regression.md and ai-eval-spec.md route AI/RAG quality regressions through baseline, no-secrets dataset policy, prompt/context, retrieval metrics, judge rubric, threshold, latency, cost, grounding, one-factor-at-a-time change, rerun command, failure examples and residual risk before model, prompt, retrieval, dataset, rubric, or threshold changes.
  • native-mobile-feature.md routes iOS/Android/native mobile changes through platform assumptions, permissions, offline state, simulator/emulator, device, logs, screenshots, build command, runtime evidence, manual device gap and approval before permission, signing, store or runtime behavior claims.
  • desktop-local-first.md routes desktop/local-first changes through desktop platform assumptions, filesystem permissions, local data, local DB, indexing, background jobs, privacy, app logs, runtime log check, build command, recovery path, rollback, runtime evidence, manual OS gap and approval before filesystem access, local data, packaging, signing, distribution or runtime behavior claims.
  • data-migration.md routes schema, backfill, retention and sensitive-data changes through a migration plan, database dictionary, data quality, PII, sensitive fields, rollback, validation, dry run, backup, owner review, production DB boundary and approval before production data access, production DB access or migration execution.
  • security-sensitive-change.md and security-risk-review.md route authn, authz, permissions, payment, billing, secrets, PII, sensitive data, abuse controls, rate limit, audit logging, tests, rollback, owner review, approval and explicit Codex Security boundaries before implementation or release.
  • ci-stabilization.md and ci-stabilization-report.md route failing or flaky CI through failing job, command, logs, environment, deterministic/flaky classification, failure evidence, isolation plan, local reproduction, rerun evidence, remote CI/GitHub Actions boundary, approval and residual risk before implementation, remote CI mutation, or CI health claims.
  • release-packaging.md and release-readiness.md route package, SDK, plugin, app, desktop, mobile, or open-source release prep through release scope, package metadata, version/SemVer, changelog, build evidence, test evidence, docs evidence, security notes, license notes, artifacts, package registry, owner review, publish approval, tag boundary, rollback and residual risk before publishing, tagging, release creation, artifact upload, or package registry mutation.

These workflow templates may be promoted to skills later only after manual success evidence and failure logs justify that promotion.

docs.title: Agent team
docs.text:
Generated custom agents are project-scoped in .codex/agents/.

Agent Purpose Default reasoning Default sandbox product-manager Requirements, scope, acceptance criteria medium / high read-only architect Decomposition, ownership, risks, rollback high / xhigh read-only explorer Read-heavy codebase and docs mapping low / medium read-only builder Scoped implementation medium / high workspace-write tester Test gaps, verification commands, eval reports medium / high workspace-write reviewer Correctness, security, regressions, missing tests high / xhigh read-only docs-maintainer Docs, changelog, release notes low / medium workspace-write release-operator PR packet, rollout notes, automation candidates medium / high read-only by default

Every role card includes:

role: ""
owns: ""
does_not_do: []
inputs: []
outputs: []
model_policy:
  default_model: "project-default"
  reasoning_effort: "low | medium | high | xhigh"
  escalate_when: []
  downgrade_when: []
handoff:
  next_roles: []
  required_fields:
    - "sources_used"
    - "assumptions"
    - "files_touched_or_proposed"
    - "verification_evidence"
    - "open_risks"
stop_conditions: []

docs.title: Handoff contracts
docs.text:
All agent and skill handoffs use structured payloads.

handoff:
  lifecycle_state: ""
  goal: ""
  constraints: []
  allowed_sources: []
  inputs_used: []
  verified_claims: []
  unsupported_claims: []
  files_touched: []
  files_proposed: []
  commands_run: []
  verification_evidence: []
  risks: []
  next_agent_task: ""
  stop_reason: ""

If a handoff lacks goal, constraints, files_touched/files_proposed, or verification_evidence, the orchestrator rejects it and asks for a corrected handoff.

docs.title: Safety and approvals
docs.text:
Default project config proposal:

approval_policy = "on-request"
sandbox_mode = "workspace-write"
allow_login_shell = false

For read-only planning and review:

approval_policy = "untrusted"
sandbox_mode = "read-only"
allow_login_shell = false

Granular approval policy proposal for governed projects:

approval_policy = { granular = {
  sandbox_approval = true,
  rules = true,
  mcp_elicitations = true,
  request_permissions = false,
  skill_approval = true
} }

Approval required for:

  • external writes;
  • destructive commands;
  • permission changes;
  • global config changes;
  • credential, deployment, billing, database, auth, migration, production operation or source-of-truth update;
  • starting automation;
  • enabling broad network access.

Forbidden by default:

  • storing secrets in docs, prompts, memory, fixtures or examples;
  • editing generated/vendor/build artifacts unless explicitly allowed;
  • changing global Codex config;
  • creating recurring automation without manual stability evidence;
  • claiming checks passed without running them in the current lifecycle step.

docs.title: Hooks and rules
docs.text:
Plugin provides hook templates, not silent enforcement.

Hook Event Purpose Blocking session_start_context.py SessionStart Summarize active control-plane state no pre_tool_use_policy.py PreToolUse Detect destructive commands and forbidden paths yes for high-risk matches permission_request_summary.py PermissionRequest Explain why approval is requested no post_tool_use_evidence.py PostToolUse Append command evidence to active runlog buffer no stop_runlog_reminder.py Stop Remind to update RUNLOG.md when evidence exists no by default

Rules must be narrow, auditable and aligned with sandbox/approvals. Hooks must not store secrets.

docs.title: Runtime selection
docs.text:
Project need Runtime decision First-time project setup Codex App or CLI interactive One prepared task packet codex exec Large feature App/CLI with worktree per coherent unit PR review GitHub integration or Codex review flow Recurring stable check Codex automation or GitHub Action Programmable multi-agent workflow Agents SDK + Codex MCP GUI-only task Computer Use only when no dedicated tool exists

Runtime choice is stored in PLAN.md or RUNLOG.md, not hidden in chat.

docs.title: Context7 and source policy
docs.text:
The Track 3 source-context-pack.md workflow template records Context7 usage for library and official documentation retrieval when current docs are required.

Rules:

  • Official status applies only when underlying source is official.
  • Context7 results from community repositories are intake material until verified.
  • OpenAI product claims prefer official OpenAI docs.
  • Source-backed claims update source registry or project source notes.
  • Community tricks are stored as insights with trust_level and verification_status.

docs.title: Evals and verification
docs.text:
Plugin has its own eval suite and creates project evals.

Plugin fixture evals:

Case Fixture Expected behavior Happy path node-app Creates control plane, agents, test plan, runlog, no unsafe write Existing files existing-codex-config Preserves user content and proposes managed sections Missing tests empty-repo Names test gap and does not invent passing checks Unsafe write Any fixture Stages draft and requests approval Monorepo monorepo Creates nested ownership and avoids overlapping write scopes Source conflict docs-repo Marks conflict and requests verification Failed verification python-app Reports failure evidence and does not claim completion

Project evals:

  • deterministic checks: tests, lint, build, docs checks, schema validation;
  • LLM-as-judge checks: usefulness, clarity, source fidelity, handoff completeness;
  • artifact inspection: screenshots, generated reports, deployment previews, PR body;
  • regression checks: previous passing scenarios remain passing.

Stopping rule example:

quality_gate:
  deterministic_checks_required: true
  no_blocking_review_findings: true
  llm_judge_average_min: 0.90
  no_unresolved_source_conflicts: true
  rollback_note_required_for_risky_change: true

docs.title: Automation promotion
docs.text:
automation-promoter can only produce an automation candidate when all conditions are true:

  • workflow ran manually at least twice or has equivalent fixture evidence;
  • inputs and outputs are stable;
  • failure modes are known;
  • write policy is explicit;
  • verification is runnable;
  • owner and cadence are named;
  • external writes are staged or approval-gated.

Automation candidate packet:

automation_candidate:
  name: ""
  purpose: ""
  trigger_or_cadence: ""
  required_inputs: []
  write_policy: "read_only | draft_only | approved_write"
  verification: []
  failure_modes: []
  owner: ""
  rollback_or_disable: ""

docs.title: Optional Agents SDK runner
docs.text:
For advanced teams, plugin may include a companion runner design under scripts/agents_sdk_runner/.

Architecture:

  • Manager Agent owns lifecycle state and final output.
  • Specialist agents are tools or handoff targets.
  • Codex MCP performs workspace work with explicit sandbox and approval policy.
  • Guardrails validate handoff completeness, tool boundary, source fidelity and no secret retention.
  • Sessions preserve conversation continuity.
  • Tracing records tools, handoffs, latency and failures.

This runner is optional because many projects need Codex plugin + skills + .codex/ config before they need a programmable agent app.

docs.title: Failure modes
docs.text: Failure Detection Required behavior Scope too broad Requirements span unrelated systems Split into phases and ask for priority Existing project rules conflict AGENTS.md and proposed config disagree Stop and show conflict Context overflow Runlog or docs too large Build context pack and archive old details Agent edits outside ownership Diff touches unassigned files Stop or request approval Verification missing No test/eval command known Create test gap and avoid success claim Hook false positive Valid command blocked Log rule, propose narrower rule Automation too early No manual success history Keep as candidate, not active automation Source drift Official docs changed Mark freshness risk and refresh source Secret risk Potential credential detected Stop, redact, do not store

docs.title: Acceptance criteria
docs.text:
Plugin is production-ready when:

  • It can initialize existing and greenfield projects without overwriting user content.
  • It produces a clear infrastructure plan before writing.
  • It routes skills by lifecycle state and complexity profile.
  • It creates valid control-plane files and project-scoped .codex/ assets.
  • It supports full project lifecycle from idea to PR/release packet.
  • It logs evidence and decisions in RUNLOG.md.
  • It handles context overflow through hot/warm/cold context layers and archive policy.
  • It enforces approval gates for risky writes.
  • It has fixture evals for happy path, existing config, missing tests, unsafe write, monorepo, source conflict and failed verification.
  • It does not create active automations without stability evidence.
  • It documents residual risks and next action after every run.

docs.title: Implementation handoff
docs.text:
Implementation should be split into four build tracks:

  1. Plugin core and contracts - manifest, schemas, detection scripts, validators, fixture harness.
  2. Lifecycle skills - orchestrator and each lifecycle stage skill with concise SKILL.md, references and output contracts.
  3. Generated project infrastructure - control-plane templates, .codex/agents/*.toml, hooks, workflow packets and eval templates.
  4. Production hardening - fixture evals, safe merge behavior, source policy checks, automation promotion gates and optional Agents SDK runner.

Each track must have deterministic validation before the plugin is used on real customer projects.

docs.title: Роли агентной команды
docs.text: Source status: official + experiment Источники: A practical guide to building agents, Codex with Agents SDK, Subagents, Codex models, Agents SDK models and providers, Reasoning best practices, Build AI-native engineering teams.

docs.title: Role map
docs.text: Роль Основной input Output Не делает Product Manager User request, business goal REQUIREMENTS.md, acceptance criteria Не пишет production code Architect Requirements, codebase map PLAN.md, component boundaries Не расширяет scope Builder Plan, ownership Code diff, tests Не меняет чужой write scope Tester Requirements, diff, test plan Test gaps, failing cases, eval report Не принимает неподтвержденные claims Reviewer Diff, risk model Findings ordered by severity Не переписывает без запроса Docs Maintainer Diff, sources, decisions Docs, release notes Не смешивает official/community Release Operator Verification, PR body PR, changelog, rollout notes Не пропускает failing checks

docs.title: Model and reasoning profile
docs.text:
Каждая роль должна иметь execution profile. Это особенно важно для programmable Agents SDK workflows и Codex custom agents, где модель и reasoning могут задаваться явно.

Роль Model policy Reasoning effort Escalation rule Product Manager gpt-5.5 или project default medium / high Поднять до high, если requirements конфликтуют или нужно выбрать tradeoff Architect gpt-5.5 high / xhigh xhigh для multi-system architecture, migrations, deep debugging Builder project default; gpt-5.4-mini для малых scoped edits medium / high high, если меняются shared contracts или несколько модулей Explorer gpt-5.4-mini или project default low / medium medium, если нужно синтезировать найденные зависимости Tester project default medium high, если failure non-deterministic или eval-driven Reviewer gpt-5.5 high xhigh, если review затрагивает security, data loss, concurrency, auth Docs Maintainer project default low / medium medium, если нужно сверять несколько official sources Release Operator project default medium high, если rollout irreversible или approvals неоднозначны

Минимальная role card:

role: "Architect"
owns: "Architecture, decomposition, risk analysis"
model_policy:
  model: "gpt-5.5"
  reasoning_effort: "high"
  cost_latency_budget: "quality-first"
  inherit_from_parent_when_unspecified: true
  override_allowed_by:
    - "run-level workflow config"
    - "human approval"
  escalation_rules:
    - "Use xhigh for multi-system migration or ambiguous architecture."
    - "Use medium for bounded implementation planning."
handoff:
  inputs: "REQUIREMENTS.md, codebase map, constraints"
  outputs: "PLAN.md, risks, open questions, verification strategy"

Project default должен жить в PLAN.md или project-scoped agent config. Durable rules о том, когда повышать reasoning, можно хранить в AGENTS.md; одноразовые runtime overrides лучше фиксировать в RUNLOG.md.

docs.title: Manager pattern
docs.text:
Для product delivery default - Manager pattern:

  • Manager держит цель, scope и gates.
  • Specialist agents выполняют bounded tasks.
  • Verifier/Reviewer проверяет результат.
  • Manager публикует итог и решает, что переносить в docs/skills.
flowchart TD
    M["Manager"] --> PM["Product spec"]
    M --> A["Architecture plan"]
    M --> B["Builder"]
    M --> T["Tester"]
    M --> R["Reviewer"]
    M --> D["Docs maintainer"]
    PM --> M
    A --> M
    B --> M
    T --> M
    R --> M
    D --> M

docs.title: Handoff rule
docs.text:
Каждая роль должна возвращать не только output, но и:

  • sources used;
  • assumptions;
  • files touched or proposed;
  • verification evidence;
  • open risks;
  • recommended next role.

docs.title: Product-Agent OS plugin
docs.text:
Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex plugins, Build plugins, Agent Skills, Subagents, AGENTS.md, Codex hooks, Agent approvals and security, Codex workflows, Product-Agent Workflows.

product-agent-os - локальный Codex plugin для проектов, где Codex App, CLI, IDE extension, subagents, skills, AGENTS.md, hooks, evals и automation candidates должны работать как управляемая система delivery, а не как набор разовых prompts.

Плагин не заменяет владельца продукта и не включает автономные изменения сам по себе. Его задача - превратить workspace в управляемый lifecycle: read-only audit, требования, план, team ownership, staged infrastructure, проверки, review, release packet, learning loop и только затем automation candidate. Новый слой Engineering standards layer добавляет product hypothesis, architecture boundary, test-first/eval-first gates, docs-as-code, release measurement, discovery signals и concrete artifact templates как обязательные элементы зрелой разработки.

docs.title: Какие боли решает
docs.text: Боль Что делает plugin Длинная Codex-сессия теряет контекст Выносит цель, план, проверки и решения в control-plane files Требования живут только в чате Создает REQUIREMENTS.md с scope, non-goals и acceptance criteria Планирование смешивается с implementation Требует PLAN.md, ownership, verification и rollback до build slice Subagents работают без границ Проектирует роли через ownership, handoff artifacts и stop conditions Проверки называются задним числом Разделяет deterministic checks в TEST.md и quality gates в EVALS.md Агент пишет код без инженерной методологии Добавляет product hypothesis, architecture boundary, test/eval-first path, docs impact и measurement Проектные правила размазаны по memory Переносит durable rules в AGENTS.md, а текущие решения в RUNLOG.md Hooks и automations включаются слишком рано Ставит staged-first и candidate-only boundary до ручного approval Невозможно доказать, что работа verified Требует evidence: команды, fixture evals, source policy и review findings

docs.title: Кому подходит
docs.text: Сценарий Польза Solo developer Быстро структурировать feature и не потерять acceptance criteria Product engineer Вести работу от идеи до PR packet через проверяемые artifacts Engineering team Разделить worktrees, roles и write scopes без конфликтов AI product team Добавить eval-driven loop и source/context policy Governed workspace Сохранить approvals, staged writes, rollback и audit trail

docs.title: Основной lifecycle
docs.text:
flowchart LR
    A["Idea"] --> B["Workspace audit"]
    B --> C["REQUIREMENTS.md"]
    C --> D["PLAN.md"]
    D --> E["Agent team"]
    E --> F["Build slice"]
    F --> G["TEST.md / EVALS.md"]
    G --> H["Review"]
    H --> I["PR or release packet"]
    I --> J["RUNLOG.md learning"]
    J --> K["Automation candidate"]

Plugin держит lifecycle последовательным. Он не должен перескакивать из uninitialized сразу в build_active: сначала нужны context, requirements, plan, ownership и quality gates.

docs.title: Текущий Track 8 статус
docs.text:
Новый план различает готовые workflows, done methodology gates, partial methodology gates и pending сценарии:

Уровень Что это означает Сценарии done Есть route, staged workflow/artifact templates, behavioral evals и текущая verification evidence. first-run intake, bug rescue, greenfield idea, complex system acceleration, PR review, legacy onboarding, API migration, AI/RAG eval regression, native/mobile, desktop local-first, data migration, security-sensitive change, CI stabilization, release packaging. done methodology gate Есть reusable gate, templates, behavioral eval и fixture coverage. no-placeholder planning, generalized two-stage review, fresh-context handoff, acceptance scenarios, conditional DDD domain modeling, bounded-context-to-architecture traceability, ubiquitous language traceability, conditional FSD structure routing, metric hardening, evidence-before-completion, docs tooling selector, conditional readiness statuses. partial Есть часть системного поведения, но не весь planned contract. lifecycle trigger hardening.

docs.title: Что входит сейчас
docs.text:
• Plugin package under plugins/product-agent-os/ with .codex-plugin/plugin.json.
  • Packaged lifecycle skills: orchestrator, discovery auditor, requirements author, implementation planner, team designer, test/eval designer, risk reviewer, release operator, learning loop maintainer and automation promoter.
  • Staged infrastructure renderer for control-plane files, project-scoped .codex/agents/, hook templates, workflows, eval templates, PR/release templates and automation candidates.
  • Engineering standards workflow templates: .codex/workflows/development-standards.md and .codex/workflows/documentation-system.md.
  • Engineering standards artifact templates: .codex/artifact-templates/adr.md, architecture-overview.md, domain-modeling.md, metric-spec.md, api-contract-review.md, component-card.md and database-dictionary.md.
  • Safe merge tooling with approval record, manifest validation, workspace-bound paths and rollback support.
  • Source policy, automation candidate validation, fixture evals and Codex-only runtime runner contract mode.
  • Track 8 workflow templates for first-run intake, bug rescue, greenfield idea shaping, complex system acceleration, PR review readiness, legacy onboarding, API migration, AI/RAG eval regression, native/mobile feature work, desktop local-first work, data migration, security-sensitive change, CI stabilization and release packaging.
  • First-run route contract for empty, broken, existing control-plane and complex system starts: mode, confidence, next smallest action, minimum artifacts, evidence gaps and approval boundary.
  • No-placeholder planning gate in implementation-planner, PLAN.md, build-slice.md, plan-quality-check.md, behavioral eval and fixture eval: non-trivial slices need exact files, owned/forbidden files, exact commands, expected outputs, rollback, evidence owner and placeholder scan before build.
  • Generalized two-stage review gate in risk-reviewer, review-slice.md, RUNLOG.md, pr-risk-review.md and behavioral eval: risky PR/public-contract/migration/security/data/release/parallel slices need spec compliance before quality/risk, and missing evidence blocks ready verdicts.
  • Fresh-context handoff gate in agent-team-designer, handoff-contract.md, agent-task-packet.md, worktree-ownership.md and behavioral eval: subagents and parallel workers need complete task context, source constraints, allowed sources, inputs used, owned/forbidden files, expected evidence, handoff output schema, stop conditions and sequential fallback before work starts.
  • Acceptance scenarios gate in requirements-author, implementation-planner, test-eval-designer, generated REQUIREMENTS/TEST/EVALS, development-standards.md, acceptance-scenarios.md, readiness eval and behavioral eval: behavior changes need requirement -> scenario -> check -> evidence owner, Given/When/Then or equivalent behavior format, business rule, edge case, non-goal, explicit gap and evidence owner before implementation.
  • Conditional DDD domain modeling gate in discovery.py, domain-modeling.md, architecture-overview.md, project-readiness.json, implementation-planner and fixture eval: complex backend/workflow/enterprise/data-heavy/multi-service/multi-context work needs bounded context, bounded-context-to-architecture traceability, ubiquitous language traceability, invariant or accepted gap, while simple CRUD/MVP work is not forced into DDD.
  • Ubiquitous language traceability gate in domain-modeling.md, generated PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, project-readiness.json, implementation-planner and fixture eval: every domain term maps to requirement/source plus API/event/contract, UI label, code module or owner, or records accepted gap with domain expert review.
  • Conditional FSD structure routing in discovery.py, component-card.md, development-standards.md, project-readiness.json, workspace-discovery-auditor and implementation-planner: web UI work can use optional fsd_structure when Feature-Sliced Design layer directories are present, while backend, native, simple CRUD and simple MVP work records FSD as not applicable or accepted gap.
  • Metric hardening gate in metric-spec.md, release-packet.md, generated REQUIREMENTS/PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, project-readiness.json, lifecycle skills and fixture eval: product behavior changes need metric_hardening_when_product_behavior_changes, North Star or primary value metric, input metric, counter-metric, proxy metric risk, guardrail, qualitative review, privacy classification, retention period, data minimization, owner signoff and post-release review evidence before product success claims.
  • Evidence-before-completion gate in release-packet.md, development-standards.md, generated AGENTS/PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, project-readiness.json, lifecycle skills, behavioral eval and fixture eval: ready/completed/fixed/works/release claims need current command evidence, current eval evidence, current runtime evidence, owner evidence or explicit test gap; inspection-only answers must stay labeled.
  • Docs tooling selector in docs-tooling-decision.md, documentation-system.md, generated PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, project-readiness.json, lifecycle skills, discovery and fixture eval: docs_as_code_impact can be not_applicable, present_unverified, present_verified, proposal_staged, explicit_gap_accepted or approval_required; docs-light/internal-only projects are not forced into heavy portals, and hosted docs or DB introspection require approval.
  • Conditional readiness gates in project-readiness.json, generated AGENTS/PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, lifecycle skills and fixture eval: readiness_statuses include not_applicable, applicable_missing, present_unverified, present_verified, proposal_staged, explicit_gap_accepted and approval_required; every gate names applicability, required evidence, owner and residual risk, and detection alone cannot claim readiness.
  • Transcript/session eval runner in product_agent_os/transcript_evals.py, run_transcript_eval.py, product-agent-os-synthetic-sessions.json and fixture eval: synthetic or redacted sessions replay against behavioral-workflows.json, check expected_terms, forbidden_terms, missing_expected_terms, forbidden_terms_present and privacy_errors, and avoid external systems.
  • API migration artifact templates for migration plans and contract reviews with OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, consumers, generated clients, compatibility, deprecation, rollout, release impact and owner review gates.
  • AI eval artifact templates for baseline, no-secrets dataset policy, rubric, threshold, rerun command, latency, cost, grounding, failure examples and residual risk.
  • Native/mobile workflow coverage for platform assumptions, permissions, offline state, simulator/emulator, device, logs, screenshots, build command, runtime evidence, manual device gaps and approval boundaries.
  • Desktop local-first workflow coverage for filesystem permissions, local data, local DB, indexing, background jobs, privacy, app logs, runtime log checks, recovery path, rollback, runtime evidence and manual OS gaps.
  • Data migration workflow coverage for schema changes, backfill, data quality, PII, sensitive fields, retention, rollback, validation, dry run, backup, database dictionary, owner review, production DB boundary and approval.
  • Security-sensitive workflow coverage for threat surface, authn/authz, permissions, payment, billing, secrets, PII, sensitive data, abuse controls, rate limit, audit logging, tests, rollback, owner review, approval and explicit Codex Security boundaries.
  • CI stabilization workflow coverage for failing job, command, logs, environment, deterministic/flaky classification, isolation plan, local reproduction, rerun evidence, remote CI/GitHub Actions boundary and approval.
  • Release packaging workflow coverage for release scope, package metadata, version/SemVer, changelog, build/test/docs evidence, security and license notes, artifacts, package registry, publish approval, tag boundary, rollback and residual risk.

docs.title: Границы
docs.text:
• Plugin работает внутри Codex. Он не требует отдельного OpenAI API key и не запускает standalone Agents SDK runner.
  • Infrastructure generation is staged-first: dry-run or staging directory before any target workspace write.
  • Hooks are packaged as templates and examples; they are not silently activated.
  • Automation artifacts are candidate-only until manual workflow is stable and explicitly approved.
  • Secrets, private customer data, raw private chat logs and local absolute paths must not попадать в docs, fixtures, prompts, memory or templates.

docs.title: Куда идти дальше
docs.text:
• Технические особенности и установка - реальные файлы, команды, capabilities и install boundary.
  • Engineering standards layer - как plugin внедряет DDD/FSD/TDD/ADD, docs-as-code и eval-driven quality без превращения их в dogma.
  • Scenarios and usage modes - first response, minimum artifacts, approval boundary and verification gates for Track 8 scenarios.
  • Behavioral evals - expected behavior, forbidden behavior, fixture eval and transcript/session replay.
  • Codex compatibility - Codex App, CLI, IDE extension, .codex-plugin, skills, MCP and staged hooks support boundary.
  • Диаграммы и принципы работы - state routing, staged-first merge, approval gates and runtime runner flow.
  • Product-Agent Workflows - общий operating model без привязки к plugin package.

docs.title: Диаграммы и принципы работы
docs.text:
Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex plugins, Agent Skills, Subagents, AGENTS.md, Codex hooks, Agent approvals and security, Codex workflows, Technical features.

Эта страница показывает не историю реализации, а рабочую модель Product-Agent OS plugin: как он выбирает следующий step, как stages changes, где требует approval и почему automation remains candidate-only.

Engineering standards layer добавляет методические gates поверх lifecycle: product hypothesis, architecture boundary, test-first/eval-first path, docs-as-code impact, review и release measurement. Track 7 дополняет это discovery signals и concrete artifact templates, чтобы plugin видел существующую инженерную зрелость workspace и мог stage недостающие outputs. Эти gates не запускают внешние системы сами; они появляются в staged artifacts и должны быть подтверждены evidence.

Track 8 добавляет usage_mode route перед методическими gates. Route выбирает first response и minimum artifacts, но не отменяет lifecycle, source policy, sandbox or approvals. First-run route теперь явно различает empty workspace, failed verification, existing control-plane и complex system starts, возвращая mode, confidence, next smallest action, minimum artifacts, evidence gaps и approval boundary. После нового audit plan plugin различает done сценарии, done methodology gates, partial methodology gates и base modes. API migration, AI/RAG eval regression, native/mobile feature work, desktop local-first work, data migration, security-sensitive change, CI stabilization и release packaging имеют packaged workflows, artifacts, behavioral eval coverage and current verification evidence. Done methodology gates now include no-placeholder planning, generalized two-stage review for risky public-contract/migration/security/data/release/parallel slices, fresh-context handoff for subagents or parallel workers, acceptance scenarios with ATDD/BDD traceability before behavior changes, conditional DDD domain modeling for complex backend/workflow/enterprise/data-heavy/multi-service/multi-context work, bounded-context-to-architecture traceability, ubiquitous language traceability, conditional FSD structure routing, metric hardening for product behavior changes, evidence-before-completion for ready/completed/fixed/works/release claims, docs tooling selection, conditional readiness statuses, and deterministic transcript/session eval replay.

Docs tooling selector is part of the Track 8 methodology gate set: docs_tooling_selector records docs_as_code_impact, selected tools, rejected tools, evidence owner, maintenance owner, command evidence, accepted gaps and approval-required items. It keeps docs-light/internal-only projects lightweight and treats hosted docs, CI activation and DB introspection as explicit approval boundaries.

Conditional readiness gates are now part of the route model: project-readiness.json defines readiness_statuses and per-gate applicability, pass condition, accepted gap, required evidence, owner and residual risk. Detection alone can only create present_unverified; verified readiness requires current command, owner or artifact evidence.

For operator-facing details, use Scenarios for route selection, Behavioral evals for expected/forbidden behavior, and Codex compatibility for package-surface boundaries.

docs.title: Engineering standards route
docs.text:
flowchart LR
    S["Workspace methodology signals"] --> A["REQUIREMENTS.md hypothesis and metrics"]
    A --> B["PLAN.md architecture boundary"]
    B --> C["TEST.md test-first checks"]
    B --> D["EVALS.md quality gates"]
    C --> E["Build slice"]

docs.title: Product-Agent OS behavioral evals
docs.text:
Source status: official + experiment Источники: Codex use cases, Codex workflows, OpenAI eval best practices, Agent evals, Product-Agent OS scenarios.

Behavioral evals проверяют не синтаксис Markdown, а поведение route: правильный first response, отсутствие forbidden behavior, требуемые artifacts, evidence-before-completion и stop condition.

Главный шаблон сейчас: plugins/product-agent-os/assets/templates/evals/behavioral-workflows.json. Он дополняется fixture eval через python plugins\product-agent-os\scripts\run_fixture_eval.py и transcript/session replay через python plugins\product-agent-os\scripts\run_transcript_eval.py.

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text:
• scenario или methodology gate, который нужно проверить;
  • user prompt или synthetic route input;
  • workspace fixture, если route зависит от файлов;
  • expected behavior: mode, minimum artifacts, next action, approval boundary, evidence fields;
  • forbidden behavior: scaffold before approval, broad rewrite, unsupported ready claim, external mutation, missing source status;
  • residual risk и reason, если кейс остается only structural.

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text:
• behavioral eval case с id, prompt/context, expected behavior, forbidden behavior и evidence requirements;
  • fixture eval assertion, когда поведение можно проверить через synthetic workspace;
  • failure note для RUNLOG.md, если route или lifecycle skill пропускает shortcut;
  • transcript/session eval report with behavioral_case, expected_terms, forbidden_terms, missing_expected_terms, forbidden_terms_present and privacy_errors, если поведение зависит от многошаговой сессии.

docs.title: Eval Layers
