docs.title: Общий метод исследования
docs.text:
Для каждой методологии и инструмента применяется один и тот же протокол:

  1. Найти первичный или официальный источник.
  2. Снять 5-10 проверяемых утверждений без community-обобщений.
  3. Разделить статус утверждения: official, methodology, tool convention, community, experiment.
  4. Определить применимость: web/front-end, native/mobile, desktop, backend/API, data, AI/evals, docs, operations.
  5. Привязать к Product-Agent OS: template, workflow, skill, eval, discovery signal, docs page или staged CI proposal.
  6. Зафиксировать failure modes: где методология вредна, избыточна или требует человеческого решения.
  7. Добавить проверку: тест, eval gate, docs check, contract check, browser/runtime check или review checklist.

docs.title: Методологии разработки
docs.text: Методология Краткое описание Первичные источники Ключевая информация для plugin Agentic / AI-native development Организация SDLC, где Codex App, CLI, IDE extension, subagents и skills помогают планировать, строить, тестировать, ревьюить и документировать изменения, а человек сохраняет ownership архитектуры, продукта и качества. Codex build plugins, Agent Skills, Building an AI-Native Engineering Team, Codex AI app evals Не превращать agentic work в blind generation. Нужны scoped inputs, ownership, tests/evals, source policy, approval policy, run evidence и promotion path: manual workflow -> skill -> plugin -> automation. Data-informed development Принятие продуктовых решений через goals, signals, metrics, guardrails и post-release learning. Google HEART paper, Amplitude North Star Использовать термин data-informed product decisions, чтобы не смешивать с Domain-Driven Design. В plugin нужны metric spec, guardrail metrics, privacy notes и защита от оптимизации одного proxy metric. Domain-Driven Design Проектирование сложной бизнес-логики вокруг domain model, ubiquitous language и bounded contexts. Martin Fowler: Domain-Driven Design, Bounded Context, Ubiquitous Language, Domain Language DDD нужен для сложной предметной области, а не для каждого CRUD. Plugin должен требовать domain glossary, bounded contexts, aggregates/domain events only when justified, и explicit mapping к architecture boundary. TDD Red-Green-Refactor цикл: тест до реализации, минимальный код, refactor при зеленых тестах. Agile Alliance TDD Уже частично внедрено в Track 7. Следующий шаг: требовать evidence red -> green -> refactor в RUNLOG или gap, особенно для bugfix и shared behavior. ATDD Acceptance tests пишутся до реализации совместно с customer/product, development и testing perspectives. Agile Alliance ATDD Хороший мост между REQUIREMENTS.md и TEST.md. Plugin должен поддерживать acceptance scenarios до кода и traceability от requirement к test/eval. BDD Уточнение TDD/ATDD через behavior scenarios, business outcomes и общий язык для domain experts, testers и developers. Agile Alliance BDD Применять для пользовательского поведения и бизнес-правил. Не заменяет unit tests; дает acceptance language и сценарии для agent handoff. Feature-Sliced Design Frontend architecture methodology с layers, slices, segments, public API и import rules. Feature-Sliced Design documentation Использовать как strong default для растущего UI, но не навязывать backend/native/MVP. Discovery должен видеть FSD structure, а planner должен фиксировать layer/slice boundary. Eval-driven AI development Повторяемые eval suites для prompt/model/tool/RAG/agent behavior до изменения production behavior. Codex AI app evals, OpenAI eval best practices Для AI/RAG нельзя ограничиться unit tests. Нужны baseline, app-path target, fixtures без secrets/customer data, assertions, run command и threshold. Docs-as-code Документация живет рядом с кодом, меняется через review, собирается и проверяется как часть engineering workflow. GitLab documentation architecture, GitHub Actions workflows, GitHub protected branches Plugin должен stage proposals для docs CI/CODEOWNERS, но не включать external workflows без approval. Docs impact должен быть gate в PLAN/TEST/RUNLOG.

docs.title: Инструменты документации и инженерных артефактов
docs.text: Инструмент Краткое описание Источник Ключевая информация для plugin C4 model Уровни software architecture diagrams: system context, container, component, code; не все уровни обязательны. C4 diagrams Default architecture overview должен требовать минимум context/container для значимых системных изменений. arc42 Template для architecture communication: goals, constraints, context, solution strategy, building blocks, runtime, deployment, decisions, quality, risks. arc42 overview Полезен как структура architecture-overview template и review checklist. ADR / MADR Markdown decision records для фиксации контекста, решения, альтернатив и последствий. MADR Plugin уже генерирует ADR template; нужен next step: ADR trigger policy и ADR index/check. Structurizr DSL Text-based DSL для C4 architecture model, diagrams и Markdown/AsciiDoc docs as code. Structurizr DSL, Structurizr as code Optional advanced path для architecture-as-code; не должен быть default для маленьких repos. Mermaid Text syntax for diagrams embedded in Markdown/docs portals. Mermaid syntax Хороший default для repo-native diagrams, но нужен syntax/build check, потому что small syntax errors ломают rendering. PlantUML Text-to-diagram tooling, особенно для sequence/component/UML-style views. PlantUML sequence diagram Useful for teams already using UML/sequence diagrams; should remain optional. OpenAPI Machine-readable HTTP API contract. OpenAPI Specification latest API changes need contract update or explicit gap; core guidance should prefer latest spec reference while preserving compatibility notes. AsyncAPI Machine-readable event/message-driven API contract. AsyncAPI v3.0.0 Event-driven systems need channel/message ownership, producer/consumer roles and compatibility check. Storybook UI component workshop and docs/testing surface with Autodocs, MDX/Doc Blocks and a11y workflows. Storybook Autodocs, Storybook a11y tests UI changes should declare component states and visual/a11y checks when Storybook exists or should be proposed. TypeDoc Generates HTML docs or JSON model from TypeScript source comments/exports. TypeDoc Good for TS library/API packages; less useful for purely internal app code unless public interfaces exist. JSDoc Tag system for JavaScript documentation comments. JSDoc tags Use for public JS interfaces and editor hints; avoid low-value comments on obvious internals. Sphinx autodoc Python doc generator can import modules and inspect docstrings. Sphinx autodoc Good for Python package/reference docs; requires import-safe modules and documented public API. Javadoc Standard Java doc comments and API HTML generation. Oracle Javadoc spec Applies to public Java APIs; first sentence summary and tags matter for generated docs. C# XML docs Structured comments compiled into XML API docs. Microsoft C# XML docs Good for .NET public APIs and IntelliSense/reference docs. DBML / dbdocs Text DSL and hosted docs workflow for database schema documentation. DBML syntax, dbdocs DBML generation Database changes need schema dictionary, relation map and migration notes; DBML is a strong lightweight option. SchemaSpy Generates database schema documentation from metadata. SchemaSpy docs Useful for existing relational DBs; requires DB access and no secret leakage in generated artifacts. MkDocs Markdown + YAML static site generator with dev server and static HTML output. MkDocs Default docs portal for smaller repos and this project. Strict build should be docs quality gate. Docusaurus React/MDX documentation site generator with versioning, i18n, search and interactive pages. Docusaurus docs, Docusaurus versioning Strong for product docs with React/MDX and versioned public docs; versioning adds maintenance cost and should not be automatic. Antora Multi-repository, multi-version docs site generator for AsciiDoc. Antora, Antora features Enterprise/multirepo option; heavier than MkDocs for small repos. Read the Docs Hosted docs platform that builds docs from VCS workflow and supports versions. Read the Docs Good for public/open docs hosting; plugin should propose, not assume external hosting. CODEOWNERS GitHub ownership file for auto-requesting reviewers and optional code owner approval. GitHub CODEOWNERS Useful governance signal; Product-Agent OS may stage CODEOWNERS proposals but not enforce without approval. GitHub Actions YAML-defined workflows in .github/workflows for build/test/deploy/docs checks. GitHub Actions workflows, workflow syntax CI proposals should be staged and least-privilege. Required checks are a governance decision, not automatic plugin behavior. Vale Prose/style linter with configurable styles and spelling checks. Vale styles Good optional docs quality gate for product docs; requires team style decisions. markdownlint Markdown rule set and linter for structural consistency. markdownlint rules Lightweight docs quality gate; useful for CI proposal and local docs checks. Keep a Changelog Human-readable changelog convention with grouped change types and Unreleased section. Keep a Changelog Release packet should capture user-visible changes, deprecations, removals and security notes, not raw git logs. SemVer Versioning contract around major/minor/patch and public API compatibility. Semantic Versioning Relevant for plugins, packages, SDKs and public contracts; major changes require explicit migration notes.

docs.title: Initial gaps to investigate against Product-Agent OS
docs.text: Gap Почему важно Research action DDD conditional lifecycle gate закрыт в T8-A5, bounded context traceability закрыта в T8-A6, ubiquitous language traceability закрыта в T8-A7, conditional FSD structure routing закрыт в T8-A8, metric hardening закрыт в T8-A9, evidence-before-completion закрыт в T8-A16, docs tooling selector закрыт в T8-C, conditional readiness statuses закрыты в T8-F, dedicated scenario/eval/Codex compatibility docs закрыты в T8-H, transcript/session eval replay закрыт в T8-GY. Для сложной предметной области нужны не только bounded contexts, но и проверяемая связь domain terms с requirements, API/events, UI labels, code modules or owners; для растущего UI FSD должен быть route clue, а не forced ceremony; для product behavior metrics нужны counter-metric, guardrail, privacy and owner signoff; для completion claims нужны current command/eval/runtime evidence or inspection-only gap; для docs-as-code нужны stack-aware tooling decisions and approval statuses; для readiness нужны not_applicable, applicable_missing, present_unverified, present_verified, proposal_staged, explicit_gap_accepted and approval_required; для operator docs нужны scenario route, behavioral eval and compatibility boundaries; для transcripts нужен deterministic replay без raw private logs. Следить за human domain expert review, UI owner review, product owner metric review, docs owner review, evidence sufficiency, semantic transcript quality and standards trigger hardening; следующий Track 8 slice: T8-B standards trigger hardening. ATDD/BDD не выделены как отдельные tracks. Acceptance scenarios связывают product requirements и test/eval-first loop лучше, чем generic checklist. Implemented in acceptance-scenarios.md, control-plane templates, lifecycle skills, readiness eval and behavioral eval; residual risk is scenario quality review. Docs tooling decision matrix и docs_as_code_impact status contract закрыты в T8-C. Разным стекам нужны разные defaults: MkDocs, Docusaurus, Sphinx, Antora, Storybook, TypeDoc, OpenAPI, DBML, Mermaid, PlantUML and Structurizr; простым/internal-only проектам нужен not_applicable или lightweight docs path. Следить за качеством owner review, maintenance cost and real build evidence; selector records present_unverified until commands run. Metrics layer требует privacy and anti-Goodhart guardrails. Одна метрика может искажать поведение, а telemetry может нарушать privacy. Расширить metric-spec privacy/legal/security/guardrail fields. CI/CODEOWNERS/docs lint пока только staged proposals. Это правильно по approvals, но plugin должен ясно отличать recommendation от enforced gate. Добавить explicit proposed_not_enabled status в CI/governance templates. Architecture-as-code не классифицировано. Structurizr/Mermaid/PlantUML имеют разный вес и maintenance cost. Исследовать profile: small repo -> Mermaid, large C4 -> Structurizr, UML-heavy -> PlantUML.

docs.title: Product-Agent OS: финальный pre-development review
docs.text:
Source status: implementation planning + critical review

Дата: 2026-05-23. Основано на Track 8 detailed backlog, gap matrix, Track 6/7 implementation notes и сценарной проверке Product-Agent OS.

docs.title: Финальный критический анализ идеи
docs.text:
Идея Product-Agent OS сильная: plugin превращает Codex из исполнителя локальных задач в управляемую engineering operating layer. Главная ценность не в том, что plugin знает OpenAPI, Docusaurus, DBML или Storybook, а в том, что он умеет понять контекст проекта, выбрать применимые стандарты, создать staged artifacts, связать работу с tests/evals/docs и не активировать опасные внешние действия без approval.

Сильные стороны текущего backlog:

  • Есть separation of concerns: methodologies, standards/specs, documentation tooling, discovery, readiness gates, lifecycle skills, verification.
  • Есть staged-first safety model: plugin предлагает artifacts и checks, но не включает CI, hooks, hosted docs, DB introspection или automations молча.
  • Есть applicability statuses вместо примитивного present/missing, поэтому Docusaurus, PlantUML, DBML, Storybook и другие инструменты не становятся dogma.
  • Есть scenario workflows для трех наиболее важных входов: bug rescue, greenfield idea, complex system acceleration.
  • Есть test-first implementation plan: новые behavior changes должны начинаться с failing tests.

Критические риски перед разработкой:

Risk Почему опасно Как закрывать в backlog Artifact explosion Пользователь может получить слишком много файлов и потерять momentum. Ввести per-mode minimum artifact set и progressive disclosure: сначала минимум, затем advanced proposals. False confidence Наличие template может выглядеть как качество, хотя runtime verification не запускалась. Везде разделять present_unverified и present_verified; финальные ответы должны требовать command evidence. Over-governance Plugin может начать требовать enterprise-артефакты для маленького MVP. Applicability statuses, lightweight mode, not_applicable с reason. Mode ambiguity Один проект может быть одновременно bug rescue, complex system и security-sensitive. Ввести usage_mode.primary, usage_mode.secondary, confidence и routing reasons. Tool detection false positives domain/ folder, .stories.* или docs/ не доказывают зрелую методологию. Discovery должен различать signal presence, maturity evidence и verification command. Secrets/data exposure DB docs, integrations, env examples and logs могут содержать secrets/customer data. Secrets-safe inspection rules, redaction fields, approval gates for DB/external systems. Weak user experience Если plugin первым сообщением вывалит все gates, пользователь уйдет. Scenario-specific first response и short mode summary: what I found, what I need, next smallest step. Missing plugin success metrics Нельзя понять, делает ли plugin реально быстрее и качественнее. Добавить metric spec для самого plugin: time-to-first-useful-artifact, false positive gate rate, rescue resolution rate. Runtime diversity Web/API покрыты лучше, чем mobile, desktop, CI, security, release and legacy onboarding. Добавить 10 дополнительных usage scenarios и fixture coverage. Apply path ambiguity Staging уже есть, но пользователю нужен понятный путь от proposal к approved apply. В каждом scenario workflow явно указать approval/apply/rollback boundary.

Финальный вывод: Track 8 готов к разработке только после расширения сценарной матрицы. Методологии и tooling уже разложены хорошо, но plugin должен быть проверен на типовых жизненных ситуациях, а не только на списке стандартов.

docs.title: Addendum: behavioral evals and Codex-only scope
docs.text:
После сравнительного анализа obra/superpowers backlog требует не multi-harness adapters, а behavioral workflow evals внутри Codex-only scope. Product-Agent OS должен проверять правильное поведение plugin в Codex App, CLI, IDE extension и .codex-plugin: route selection, first response, shortcut resistance, root-cause bug rescue, no-placeholder plans, two-stage review, fresh-context handoffs and finish options.

Ограничение: идеи из Superpowers используются как community/opensource intake, а не как source of truth. Product-Agent OS не должен добавлять обязательные Claude/Cursor/OpenCode/Gemini adapters, aggressive always-on hooks или unconditional skill triggers. Любая session-start/bootstrap логика остается staged/approval-bound Codex hook proposal.

docs.title: 1. PR review before merge
docs.text:
Контекст: разработчик открыл PR, но хочет быстро проверить риски перед review.

Plugin:

  1. Делает audit diff/changed files.
  2. Классифицирует режим как pr_review.
  3. Строит risk map: behavior, API, DB, UI, security, docs, release impact.
  4. Проверяет acceptance scenarios and tests/evals coverage.
  5. Если затронут API, требует OpenAPI/AsyncAPI update или explicit gap.
  6. Если есть public contract, требует changelog/SemVer impact.
  7. Возвращает review packet: findings, missing checks, commands to run, docs impact, release risk.

docs.title: 2. Legacy repo onboarding and documentation debt
docs.text:
Контекст: команда получила старый repo без актуальной документации.

Plugin:

  1. Делает read-only inventory.
  2. Классифицирует режим как legacy_onboarding.
  3. Строит system map: entrypoints, services, scripts, tests, config, docs, known risks.
  4. Не пытается сразу переписывать код.
  5. Создает staged onboarding-map.md: как запустить, где архитектурные границы, где отсутствует source of truth.
  6. Предлагает minimum docs set: README, architecture overview, runbook, docs tooling decision.
  7. Помечает claims как present_unverified, пока commands не запускались.

docs.title: 3. API contract migration
docs.text:
Контекст: нужно изменить или версионировать HTTP API.

Plugin:

  1. Классифицирует режим как api_migration.
  2. Находит OpenAPI/Swagger tooling, generated clients, consumers, integration tests.
  3. Создает migration plan: backward compatibility, breaking changes, deprecation, examples, auth/errors.
  4. Обновляет API contract proposal before code.
  5. Требует contract tests and client impact review.
  6. Добавляет release/version impact and changelog section.

docs.title: 4. AI/RAG quality regression
docs.text:
Контекст: AI feature стала хуже отвечать, retrieval ошибается или вырос hallucination risk.

Plugin:

  1. Классифицирует режим как ai_eval_regression.
  2. Не правит prompt вслепую.
  3. Создает/обновляет ai-eval-spec.md: dataset, baseline, rubric, thresholds, no-secrets policy.
  4. Запускает или предлагает eval command.
  5. Меняет только один фактор за цикл: prompt, retrieval, reranker, chunking, model или tool.
  6. Сравнивает baseline vs new result and logs residual risk.

docs.title: 5. Mobile/native feature with permissions and offline states
docs.text:
Контекст: нужно добавить feature в iOS/Android/native app.

Plugin:

  1. Классифицирует режим как native_mobile_feature.
  2. Проверяет platform build commands, simulator/emulator assumptions, permissions, offline states, screenshots/logs.
  3. Создает acceptance scenarios for flows and permission states.
  4. Требует runtime verification beyond code inspection.
  5. Docs tooling selector не навязывает web tooling unless shared docs exist.

docs.title: 6. Desktop/local-first app with filesystem and background jobs
docs.text:
Контекст: desktop app работает с local DB, файловой системой, индексатором или background tasks.

Plugin:

  1. Классифицирует режим как desktop_local_first.
  2. Карта рисков: filesystem permissions, local DB migration, indexing, privacy, long-running work, app logs.
  3. Создает architecture boundary and data protection notes.
  4. Требует runtime check: app launch, logs, sample file path, rollback of local data migration.
  5. Документация фиксирует user data handling and recovery path.

docs.title: 7. Database migration and data model change
docs.text:
Контекст: меняется schema, migration, retention, backfill или critical query.

Plugin:

  1. Классифицирует режим как data_migration.
  2. Требует migration plan before implementation.
  3. Обновляет database dictionary/DBML proposal.
  4. Проверяет PII/sensitive fields, retention, backfill, rollback, data quality checks.
  5. Не запускает DB introspection или production DB commands без approval.

docs.title: 8. Security/auth/payment-sensitive change
docs.text:
Контекст: затрагиваются auth, permissions, payments, secrets, personal data или external writes.

Plugin:

  1. Классифицирует режим как security_sensitive_change.
  2. Усиливает reasoning/review path and stop conditions.
  3. Создает security risk review: threat surface, authz/authn, sensitive fields, abuse controls, rollback.
  4. Требует explicit approval for external writes and secret-sensitive operations.
  5. Не сохраняет secrets in artifacts.

docs.title: 9. CI stabilization and flaky tests
docs.text:
Контекст: CI падает нестабильно, tests flaky, build pipeline unreliable.

Plugin:

  1. Классифицирует режим как ci_stabilization.
  2. Собирает failure evidence: job, command, logs, timing, environment.
  3. Разделяет deterministic failures and flaky symptoms.
  4. Предлагает smallest isolation plan: reproduce locally, narrow test, stabilize dependency/time/network assumptions.
  5. Не меняет GitHub Actions settings без approval.

docs.title: 10. Package, SDK, plugin or open-source release
docs.text:
Контекст: нужно подготовить release public artifact.

Plugin:

  1. Классифицирует режим как release_packaging.
  2. Проверяет public API, SemVer impact, changelog, docs, examples, package metadata, license/security notes.
  3. Требует tests/build/docs evidence.
  4. Готовит release packet and rollback notes.
  5. Не публикует package/release/tag без explicit approval.

docs.title: Что нужно добавить в backlog
docs.text: Category Additions Usage modes pr_review, legacy_onboarding, api_migration, ai_eval_regression, native_mobile_feature, desktop_local_first, data_migration, security_sensitive_change, ci_stabilization, release_packaging. Mode model usage_mode.primary, usage_mode.secondary, confidence, reasons, fallback mode. Workflow templates PR review, legacy onboarding, API migration, AI eval regression, native/mobile feature, desktop/local-first, data migration, security-sensitive change, CI stabilization, release packaging. Artifact templates onboarding-map.md, migration-plan.md, security-risk-review.md, ci-stabilization-report.md, release-readiness.md. Readiness gates PR risk review, migration plan, security review, native/desktop runtime verification, CI evidence, release readiness, plugin success metrics. Fixtures Synthetic fixture workspace for each scenario, with no secrets and no private customer data. UX Scenario-specific first response and minimum artifact set per mode.

docs.title: Development readiness decision
docs.text:
Before code work begins, backlog should be expanded one final time with the rows above. After that, implementation should start with failing tests for:

  1. usage mode classification;
  2. per-mode minimum artifacts;
  3. scenario workflow template registration;
  4. conditional readiness gates;
  5. fixture eval for representative workspaces.

docs.title: Product-Agent OS Track 8: детальный backlog реализации
docs.text:
Source status: official + verified methodology + implementation planning

Дата: 2026-05-23. Основано на development methodology research log, gap matrix и текущем состоянии Product-Agent OS после Track 7. Дополнено сравнительным анализом obra/superpowers как community/opensource intake source для behavioral workflow design; этот источник не является source of truth для Codex и используется только для идей, которые проходят через Product-Agent OS safety, source и eval gates.

docs.title: Цель Track 8
docs.text:
Сделать Product-Agent OS способным не просто генерировать control-plane artifacts, а выбирать и проверять инженерные методологии, стандарты и documentation tooling по контексту проекта:

  • методологии: Agentic / AI-native development, TDD, ATDD, BDD, DDD, FSD, data-informed development, eval-driven AI development, docs-as-code;
  • стандарты и specs: ADR/MADR, C4, arc42, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, SemVer, Keep a Changelog, CODEOWNERS, GitHub Actions;
  • инструменты: Swagger/OpenAPI tooling, Storybook, Mermaid, PlantUML, Structurizr DSL, DBML/dbdocs/SchemaSpy, MkDocs, Docusaurus, Sphinx, Antora, Read the Docs, TypeDoc, JSDoc, Javadoc, C# XML docs, Vale, markdownlint.

docs.title: Non-goals
docs.text:
• Не устанавливать внешние инструменты автоматически.
  • Не превращать Product-Agent OS в multi-harness adapter. Track 8 проверяет только Codex App, CLI, IDE extension, .codex-plugin, bundled skills, Context7 MCP config и staged hook templates.
  • Не включать CI, hooks, CODEOWNERS, hosted docs, GitHub Actions или automations без explicit approval.
  • Не включать aggressive always-on skill triggers или session-start hooks без staged proposal и explicit approval.
  • Не делать Docusaurus, PlantUML, DBML, Storybook или любой другой инструмент обязательным для каждого проекта.
  • Не заменять runtime verification checklist простым наличием документа.
  • Не переносить community claims в core guidance без source status и verification status.
  • Не запускать широкое исправление багов без reproduction evidence, ownership boundary и rollback notes.
  • Не scaffold-ить пустой проект до явного approval выбранного product/architecture direction.
  • Не обращаться к внешним интеграциям, production DB, hosted docs, CI settings или secret-bearing configs без explicit approval.
  • Не публиковать packages, releases, tags, docs sites, GitHub changes или external tickets без explicit approval.
  • Не считать найденные logs, folders, package scripts или docs evidence проверенными без команды, exit code и owner/reviewer evidence.

docs.title: Applicability model
docs.text:
Каждая методология, стандарт или tool должны получать не boolean present/missing, а один из статусов:

Status Значение not_applicable Для текущего стека/масштаба/изменения не нужен. applicable_missing Нужен, но не найден; требуется staged proposal или explicit gap. present_unverified Найден, но команда проверки неизвестна или не запускалась. present_verified Найден и есть актуальная проверка/артефакт evidence. proposal_staged Подготовлено предложение, но оно не применено к проекту. approval_required Требуется approval: external write, CI activation, hosted docs, DB access, secrets-sensitive operation. explicit_gap_accepted Gap зафиксирован и принят владельцем как временное решение.

docs.title: Usage mode model
docs.text:
usage_mode должен быть составным, потому что реальная задача часто пересекает несколько сценариев: например, bug rescue внутри complex system или security-sensitive API migration.

Field Meaning primary Главный режим, определяющий first response and minimum artifacts. secondary Дополнительные режимы, которые добавляют gates без смены основного workflow. confidence low, medium, high; при low plugin должен задавать короткий уточняющий вопрос или выбирать safe fallback. reasons 2-5 фактов из workspace/user prompt, почему выбран режим. fallback Безопасный режим, если classification спорная, обычно standard_feature или maintenance. first_response_contract Что plugin сообщает или спрашивает на первом ходе: выбранный режим, evidence gap, approval boundary и next smallest action. minimum_artifacts Минимальный staged artifact set для режима; advanced proposals появляются только после необходимости или approval. behavioral_eval_cases Prompt/session fixtures, которые доказывают правильный route, stop condition и отсутствие forbidden behavior.

Minimum initial modes:

bug_rescue
greenfield_idea
complex_system_acceleration
pr_review
legacy_onboarding
api_migration
ai_eval_regression
native_mobile_feature
desktop_local_first
data_migration
security_sensitive_change
ci_stabilization
release_packaging
standard_feature
docs_only
maintenance

docs.title: T8-A. Methodology gates
docs.text: ID Методология Task Plugin artifact Acceptance Eval/check Residual risk T8-A1 Agentic / AI-native development Уточнить task packet: ownership, forbidden files, approvals, run evidence, stop conditions, promotion path. development-standards.md, lifecycle skills. Каждый agent task packet содержит evidence expectations и promotion rule manual -> skill -> plugin -> automation. Template tests или skill text checks. Не превращать в бюрократию для mechanical edits. T8-A2 TDD Добавить evidence contract для Red-Green-Refactor. RUNLOG.md, TEST.md, build-slice.md. Есть поля: failing test evidence, green evidence, refactor evidence или explicit accepted gap. Template tests for required fields. Не всегда применимо к docs-only или config-only изменениям. T8-A3 ATDD Добавить acceptance-scenarios.md. .codex/artifact-templates/acceptance-scenarios.md. Связка requirement -> scenario -> check -> evidence owner. Registry/template tests, fixture eval. Не дублировать REQUIREMENTS.md; template должен быть traceability artifact. T8-A4 BDD Добавить behavior scenario format без догматического forcing. acceptance-scenarios.md, development-standards.md. Есть Given/When/Then или эквивалент, business rule, edge case, non-goal, evidence. Template tests. BDD не заменяет unit, integration и contract tests. T8-A5 DDD Ввести conditional domain modeling gate. domain-modeling.md, project-readiness.json, implementation-planner skill. Для complex backend/workflow/data-heavy проекта требуется bounded context, ubiquitous language, invariant или accepted gap. Eval gate + discovery test. Не навязывать DDD простому CRUD/MVP. T8-A6 Bounded Context Добавить domain_model signal и traceability к architecture boundary. discovery.py, domain-modeling.md, architecture-overview.md, project-readiness.json, implementation-planner, fixture eval. Discovery видит domain docs/glossary/context map; planner связывает context с boundary или accepted gap. Discovery/template/lifecycle/fixture tests. Папка domain/ сама по себе не доказывает DDD maturity; mapping still needs human architecture/domain review. T8-A7 Ubiquitous Language Усилить domain template traceability. domain-modeling.md, project-readiness.json, implementation-planner, fixture eval. Term maps to requirement/source, API/event/contract, UI label, code module or owner, or accepted gap. Template/lifecycle/fixture tests. Требуется human review domain expert. T8-A8 FSD Добавить optional fsd_structure signal и FSD boundary prompt. discovery.py, component-card.md, development-standards.md, project-readiness.json, lifecycle skills. Detection понимает app/pages/widgets/features/entities/shared; planner требует public API/import boundary для растущего UI only when applicable. Focused T8-A8 discovery/template/lifecycle tests. Не применять к backend/native/simple CRUD/simple MVP без UI architecture need. T8-A9 Data-informed development Усилить metric spec. metric-spec.md, release-packet.md, generated control-plane templates, lifecycle skills, fixture eval. Есть metric_hardening_when_product_behavior_changes, North Star or primary value metric, input/counter metrics, guardrails, qualitative review, privacy classification, retention period, data minimization, owner signoff and post-release review evidence. Focused T8-A9 template/lifecycle/fixture tests. Metrics can still be wrong; нужна product owner and post-release review. T8-A10 Eval-driven AI development Добавить AI/RAG eval spec. .codex/artifact-templates/ai-eval-spec.md, EVALS.md, TEST.md. Есть baseline, fixtures policy, no-secrets rule, task rubric, thresholds, rerun command, regression handling. Template tests, fixture eval. Eval quality зависит от dataset and judge calibration. T8-A11 Docs-as-code Close inside T8-C: introduce docs impact gate with applicability status. documentation-system.md, docs-tooling-decision.md, project-readiness.json, generated PLAN/TEST/EVALS/RUNLOG, lifecycle skills. Docs impact can be not_applicable, present_unverified, present_verified, proposal_staged, explicit_gap_accepted, or approval_required; status must name evidence owner, commands, accepted gap or approval boundary. Template/readiness/fixture tests inside T8-C. Do not activate CI/CODEOWNERS, hosted docs, external sharing, DB introspection or docs publication without approval. T8-A12 Systematic debugging Усилить bug rescue через root-cause workflow. bug-rescue.md, bug-rescue-report.md, risk-reviewer skill. До fix есть symptom, expected/actual, reproduction evidence, boundary trace, hypotheses, eliminated causes и stop condition при no-repro. Behavioral eval + template tests for root cause phases. Можно перегрузить маленькие баги; lightweight path должен принимать one-command repro. T8-A13 No-placeholder implementation planning Запретить vague implementation steps в plan packets. implementation-planner skill, PLAN.md, build-slice.md. Каждый slice имеет exact files, explicit commands, expected result, rollback и evidence owner; no placeholder tokens, repeated-by-reference steps or vague validation. Skill text tests + plan-quality behavioral fixture. Слишком детальный plan может тормозить trivial docs edits; нужен mechanical_change exception with reason. T8-A14 Two-stage review Разделить review на spec compliance и quality/risk. review-slice.md, risk-reviewer skill, RUNLOG.md. Review packet сначала сверяет acceptance criteria/source constraints, затем проверяет code quality, tests, security, docs, release impact. Template tests check two verdicts. Удваивает review overhead; применять к risky/parallel/public changes. T8-A15 Fresh-context subagent handoff Уточнить task packet для subagents. agent-team-designer skill, handoff-contract.md, worktree-ownership.md. Каждый subagent получает complete task context, owned files, forbidden files, verification evidence expected и handoff output schema. Skill text tests + scenario fixture for complex acceleration. Parallel work без ownership все равно рискован; default должен быть sequential when conflict exists. T8-A16 Evidence-before-completion Зафиксировать финальный verification gate. release-packet.md, development-standards.md, generated control-plane templates, lifecycle skills, readiness eval, behavioral eval, fixture eval. Release/ready/completed/fixed/works claims допустимы только с current command evidence, current eval evidence, current runtime evidence или explicit inspection-only gap. Focused T8-A16 tests, fixture eval completion_evidence_contract_present. Быстрое мнение должно маркироваться как inspection-only; evidence sufficiency still needs human review.

docs.title: T8-B. Standards and specifications
docs.text: ID Standard/spec Task Plugin artifact Acceptance Eval/check Residual risk T8-B1 ADR/MADR Добавить ADR trigger policy. adr.md, documentation-system.md, risk-reviewer skill. ADR required/proposed for architecture boundary, storage, API contract, auth/security, irreversible migration, automation activation. Template/skill text tests. Не каждый decision требует ADR; нужен not_applicable. T8-B2 C4 Уточнить minimum diagrams by complexity. architecture-overview.md, docs tooling decision. Small: context/container optional Mermaid; larger: context/container expected; component/code only when useful. Template tests. Diagram render в target repo зависит от tooling. T8-B3 arc42 Добавить architecture quality rubric. EVALS.md, architecture-overview.md. Architecture review включает goals, constraints, context, decisions, quality attributes, risks. Eval/template tests. Rubric subjective; нужен reviewer evidence. T8-B4 OpenAPI Уточнить OpenAPI vs Swagger. api-contract-review.md, docs tooling selector. OpenAPI is source of truth; Swagger UI/tooling is optional renderer/editor/lint ecosystem. Template tests. Tool versions differ; no forced install. T8-B5 AsyncAPI Добавить producer/consumer compatibility fields. api-contract-review.md. Event contract includes channel, message, payload schema, producer, consumer, ordering/idempotency, compatibility check. Template tests. Event semantics часто не выражаются полностью схемой. T8-B6 SemVer Добавить version impact gate. release-packet.md, pr-release-operator skill. For plugin/package/API: major/minor/patch/not applicable with rationale. Template tests. SemVer applies only when public API/version contract exists. T8-B7 Keep a Changelog Добавить human-readable release categories. release-packet.md. Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security используются when relevant. Template tests. Не превращать в raw git log. T8-B8 CODEOWNERS Добавить governance proposal status. documentation-system.md, staged infrastructure notes. CODEOWNERS status can be present_verified, proposal_staged, approval_required, not_applicable. Discovery and template tests. Requiring owners can slow small teams. T8-B9 GitHub Actions Добавить least-privilege CI proposal fields. CI/governance workflow section, docs tooling selector. Proposed workflow names commands, permissions, triggers, owners, no external activation without approval. Template tests. External system side effects require approval.

docs.title: T8-C. Documentation tooling selector
docs.text:
T8-C includes closure of T8-A11. The slice is not only a tool recommendation matrix; it must make docs-as-code impact evaluable through explicit applicability statuses and evidence. A workspace can select a lightweight/no-portal path when docs tooling is not justified, but the reason, owner and residual gap must be recorded.

Required status vocabulary for docs_as_code_impact: not_applicable, present_unverified, present_verified, proposal_staged, explicit_gap_accepted, approval_required.

ID Tool group Task Plugin artifact Selection rule Check proposal T8-C1 Docs portal Add docs-tooling-decision.md. .codex/artifact-templates/docs-tooling-decision.md. Choose MkDocs, Docusaurus, Sphinx, Antora, Read the Docs, or none based on stack, repo topology, public docs, versioning need. mkdocs build, docusaurus build, sphinx-build, antora, hosted approval note where applicable. T8-C2 MkDocs Keep as simple Markdown default. Docs tooling selector. Small/medium repo, Markdown docs, simple static site, Python-friendly tooling. Strict build if installed. T8-C3 Docusaurus Recommend for React/MDX/product docs. Docs tooling selector. React/MDX-heavy docs, interactive pages, public docs, i18n/versioning needs. Build command only if package script/tool exists. T8-C4 Sphinx Recommend for Python reference docs. Docs tooling selector, code reference docs routing. Python package/library, public Python API, docstrings, API reference. sphinx-build proposal, import-safety warning. T8-C5 Antora Recommend for enterprise/multirepo AsciiDoc. Docs tooling selector. Multirepo/multiversion docs, AsciiDoc governance, larger org. Antora build proposal only if tooling exists or approved. T8-C6 Read the Docs Keep hosted docs as approval-bound option. Docs tooling selector. Public/open docs needing hosted builds/versioning. approval_required for external hosting/sharing. T8-C7 OpenAPI/Swagger Route HTTP API docs. api-contract-review.md, selector. HTTP API or SDK consumers. Swagger is UI/tooling around OpenAPI, not source of truth. OpenAPI lint/build command slot. T8-C8 AsyncAPI Route event/message docs. api-contract-review.md, selector. Queues, event bus, message-driven APIs. AsyncAPI lint/docs build slot. T8-C9 Storybook Route UI component docs. component-card.md, selector, discovery. Reusable UI components, design system, component states. Storybook build, a11y/visual check if present. T8-C10 Mermaid Default text diagrams. architecture-overview.md, selector. Markdown docs, simple diagrams, no heavy architecture-as-code need. Docs build/render check. T8-C11 PlantUML Optional UML/sequence diagrams. Selector. Team already uses PlantUML/UML or needs complex sequence/component diagrams. PlantUML render proposal only if tool exists/approved. T8-C12 Structurizr DSL Optional C4 architecture-as-code. Selector. Larger/multiservice systems needing C4 model, views, ADR/docs as code. Structurizr validate/export proposal. T8-C13 DBML/dbdocs Database docs lightweight path. database-dictionary.md, selector. Relational DB schema docs, readable schema dictionary. DBML validation/docs proposal; no connection strings. T8-C14 SchemaSpy Existing DB introspection path. Selector/database docs workflow. Existing relational DB where introspection is approved. approval_required if DB access needed; no secrets in artifacts. T8-C15 TypeDoc/JSDoc JS/TS reference docs. Selector/code reference docs section. Public TS/JS packages, SDKs, libraries. TypeDoc/JSDoc build proposal if scripts exist. T8-C16 Sphinx/Javadoc/C# XML docs Language-native reference docs. Selector/code reference docs section. Public Python/Java/.NET APIs. Stack-specific docs build proposal. T8-C17 Vale/markdownlint Optional docs quality lint. Selector/docs governance section. Public docs, regulated terminology, existing docs lint culture. Proposal staged; no CI enablement without approval.

docs.title: T8-CY. Codex-only compatibility contract
docs.text:
Track 8 borrows the idea of explicit runtime compatibility checks, but scopes it only to Codex. Product-Agent OS must not add or require Claude, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Droid or generic multi-harness adapters.

ID Surface Task Plugin artifact Acceptance Eval/check Residual risk T8-CY1 Codex plugin manifest Harden .codex-plugin/plugin.json checks. .codex-plugin/plugin.json, test_plugin_structure.py. Manifest includes valid name/version/description, skills, optional MCP config, interface metadata and Codex-safe links. Plugin structure tests. Marketplace requirements may evolve; official Codex docs stay source of truth. T8-CY2 Codex App / CLI / IDE extension Document supported Codex surfaces only. plugins/product-agent-os/README.md, docs update. README states Product-Agent OS supports Codex App, CLI and IDE extension workflows; no non-Codex install promises. Docs check + keyword tests. Different Codex surfaces may expose skills/tools differently; behavior must be framed by available capabilities. T8-CY3 Skills routing Validate bundled Product-Agent OS skills. skills/*/SKILL.md, test_lifecycle_skills.py. Skill descriptions, triggers, boundaries, inputs, outputs, verification and failure modes are present. Skill structure tests. Trigger quality still needs behavioral prompt evals, not only text checks. T8-CY4 Context7 MCP Keep Context7 as optional Codex MCP config. .mcp.json, README.md. MCP config remains secret-free and uses project/user configuration for any API key. Plugin structure tests and source-policy validation. Network and package availability vary; plugin cannot assume Context7 startup. T8-CY5 Staged hooks Keep hook templates inactive by default. assets/templates/hooks/*, merge_infrastructure.py. Hooks can be staged and approved, but plugin does not silently activate session-start behavior. Hook activation gate tests. Users may manually activate hooks incorrectly; docs must state approval and rollback path. T8-CY6 Non-Codex adapter exclusion Make absence of non-Codex manifests intentional. test_codex_compatibility.py, README. Tests fail if Track 8 requires .claude-plugin, .cursor-plugin, .opencode, Gemini extension or non-Codex install path. Focused compatibility test. Repo may contain unrelated docs about other ecosystems; test should target Product-Agent OS package only.

docs.title: T8-CX. Usage scenario workflows
docs.text: ID Scenario Task Plugin artifact Acceptance Eval/check Residual risk T8-S1 Bug rescue Add workflow for users who are stuck in bugs after exploratory or vibe-coded work. .codex/workflows/bug-rescue.md, optional .codex/artifact-templates/bug-rescue-report.md. Workflow requires symptom, expected/actual behavior, reproduction command or manual repro, failing evidence, suspect boundary, files in/out of scope, regression test path, rollback notes. Template tests check reproduction/evidence/rollback fields; discovery test can classify bug_rescue from failed tests/logs/user prompt context. If no reproduction exists, plugin must stop at diagnosis packet, not pretend to fix. T8-S2 Greenfield idea Add workflow for empty folder or idea-stage work before scaffold. .codex/workflows/greenfield-idea-to-plan.md, optional .codex/artifact-templates/greenfield-idea-brief.md. Workflow creates staged requirements, options, non-goals, first vertical slice, acceptance scenarios, metric spec, docs/tooling decision and approval gate before any scaffold. Template tests check no-scaffold-before-approval language and first-slice fields. Over-planning can slow small ideas; workflow must support lightweight mode. T8-S3 Complex system acceleration Add workflow for experienced developers scaling web/API/integration-heavy systems. .codex/workflows/complex-system-acceleration.md, .codex/artifact-templates/integration-catalog.md. Workflow maps web/API/integration/DB/docs/eval slices, ownership boundaries, parallelization rules, external system contracts, integration risks and release gates. Template tests check integration catalog, ownership, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, DB/docs, release gates. Risk of over-parallelization and conflicting file ownership. T8-S4 Usage mode classifier Add explicit route before methodology gates. discovery.py, runner route packet, workspace-discovery-auditor skill. Audit returns usage_mode for base and extended modes, plus route_inputs separating intent hints, workspace signals and control-plane state. Unit tests with synthetic workspaces, prompt-like inputs and fixture eval expectations. Mode can be ambiguous; output must include confidence and fallback path. T8-S5 Scenario handoff packet Standardize what each scenario hands to the next role. lifecycle skills and workflow templates. Handoff includes sources/context, assumptions, files touched/proposed, verification evidence, open risks, recommended next role. Skill text tests or fixture eval checks for handoff contract. Handoff packets can become verbose; keep scenario-specific minimums. T8-S6 PR review Add workflow for reviewing changed files before merge. .codex/workflows/pr-review-readiness.md, optional .codex/artifact-templates/pr-risk-review.md. Workflow maps diff to behavior/API/DB/UI/security/docs/release risks, missing checks and review evidence. Template tests for diff risk map, contract docs, release impact and commands. Requires git/diff context; if absent, route to maintenance or standard feature. T8-S7 Legacy onboarding Add workflow for old or undocumented repos. .codex/workflows/legacy-onboarding.md, .codex/artifact-templates/onboarding-map.md. Workflow creates source map, run commands, architecture/doc gaps and safe first documentation slice without refactor. Template tests check runbook, docs debt map and present_unverified wording. Discovery may infer too much from stale docs; mark unverified until commands run. T8-S8 API migration Add workflow for changing HTTP/event contracts. .codex/workflows/api-migration.md, .codex/artifact-templates/migration-plan.md. Workflow covers OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, consumers, generated clients, backwards compatibility, deprecation, examples, release impact. Template tests for contract/versioning/deprecation fields. Internal APIs may still have external consumers; require owner review. T8-S9 AI eval regression Add workflow for AI/RAG quality regression. .codex/workflows/ai-eval-regression.md, ai-eval-spec.md. Workflow requires baseline, dataset, rubric, thresholds, one-factor-at-a-time change and no-secrets fixtures. Template/eval tests for baseline and dataset policy. Eval judgments can be noisy; record confidence and residual risk. T8-S10 Native mobile feature Add workflow for iOS/Android/native mobile changes. .codex/workflows/native-mobile-feature.md. Workflow covers permissions, offline states, simulator/emulator assumptions, screenshots/logs and platform build commands. Template tests for runtime verification fields. Tooling varies heavily; plugin should propose commands from detected project only. T8-S11 Desktop local-first Add workflow for desktop apps with filesystem/local DB/background work. .codex/workflows/desktop-local-first.md. Workflow covers local data, filesystem permissions, indexing/background jobs, privacy, app logs and recovery path. Template tests for local data/rollback/log fields. Runtime verification is OS-specific; avoid claiming behavior from inspection only. T8-S12 Data migration Add workflow for schema, backfill and retention changes. .codex/workflows/data-migration.md, migration-plan.md, database-dictionary.md. Workflow covers migration, rollback, data quality, PII/sensitive fields, retention and DB docs. Template tests for migration/rollback/privacy fields. Production DB access requires approval and secret-safe handling. T8-S13 Security-sensitive change Add workflow for auth, permissions, payments, secrets or personal data. .codex/workflows/security-sensitive-change.md, .codex/artifact-templates/security-risk-review.md. Workflow covers threat surface, authn/authz, sensitive fields, abuse controls, approval needs and rollback. Template tests for approval and no-secrets wording. May require dedicated security scan outside Track 8 scope. T8-S14 CI stabilization Add workflow for failing or flaky CI. .codex/workflows/ci-stabilization.md, .codex/artifact-templates/ci-stabilization-report.md. Workflow separates deterministic failure from flake, captures job/command/log/environment evidence and proposes smallest isolation. Template tests for flake evidence and no external CI mutation. Remote CI logs may need approval or connector access. T8-S15 Release packaging Add workflow for package, SDK, plugin, app or open-source release readiness. .codex/workflows/release-packaging.md, .codex/artifact-templates/release-readiness.md. Workflow covers public API, SemVer, changelog, docs, examples, package metadata, license/security notes, publish approval and rollback. Template tests for release gates and no-publish-without-approval wording. Publishing/tagging is external/irreversible and must remain approval-bound. T8-S16 First-run route and intake Add first response contract for initial plugin use. project-lifecycle-orchestrator skill, .codex/workflows/first-run-intake.md. First response states detected/assumed usage_mode, confidence, missing context, next smallest artifact and approval boundary instead of dumping all gates. Behavioral prompt evals for empty, broken, existing and complex repos. Too many questions can stall; plugin should ask only when confidence is low or write approval is needed.

docs.title: T8-D. Discovery model
docs.text: Task Files Acceptance Verification Add usage_mode classification. plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/discovery.py Returns primary mode, secondary modes, confidence, reasons and fallback for all minimum modes. Unit tests for empty workspace, failing-test workspace, monorepo/integration-heavy workspace, docs-only workspace, PR/diff-like workspace, native/mobile, desktop, data migration, CI and release packaging fixtures. Add methodology_applicability map. plugins/product-agent-os/scripts/product_agent_os/discovery.py Done for T8-D: returns status packets per methodology/tooling gate, not only boolean signals. Focused discovery tests for packet shape/status transitions and fixture eval check methodology_applicability_contract_present. Add domain_model signal. discovery.py Done for T8-A5: detects domain modeling docs/templates/glossary/context map without treating any domain/ folder as proof. Positive/negative tests pass in focused T8-A5 suite. Add fsd_structure signal. discovery.py Detects FSD-like UI folders and avoids false positive in backend-only repos. Positive/negative tests. Add docs_tooling detail object. discovery.py Reports mkdocs, docusaurus, sphinx, antora, storybook, openapi, asyncapi, dbml, typedoc, javadoc, dotnet_xml_docs where detectable. Unit tests with synthetic files. Add code_reference_docs signal. discovery.py Detects typedoc/jsdoc/sphinx/javadoc/dotnet doc config where practical. Unit tests. Add release_policy signal. discovery.py Detects changelog, version files, package metadata when available. Unit tests. Add integration_surface signal. discovery.py Detects API clients, webhook handlers, queue/event configs, env examples, integration docs and generated clients without reading secrets. Unit tests with synthetic integration files and secret-safe fixtures. Add data_migration_signals. discovery.py Detects schema, backfill, PII, sensitive fields, retention, rollback, validation, dry run and database dictionary clues as present_unverified until run evidence or owner evidence exists. Unit tests with synthetic migration files, DBML/docs and no production data access. Add bug_reproduction_signals. discovery.py Detects failing test artifacts/log files only when present in workspace and reports them as possible evidence, not truth. Unit tests with test logs and no false positive on normal files. Add security_sensitive_surface. discovery.py Detects auth, permission, payment, secrets, PII and external-write indicators without reading secret values. Unit tests with synthetic auth/payment/env files. Add platform_runtime_surface. discovery.py Detects mobile/native and desktop/local-first project signals separately from generic web/backend. Unit tests for iOS/Android/Electron/Tauri/Swift/.NET desktop style files where practical. Add ci_failure_surface. discovery.py Detects CI workflows and local CI/failure logs as possible evidence. Unit tests for workflow files and synthetic failure logs. Add distribution_surface. discovery.py Detects package/plugin/app release metadata, changelog, version files and publishing scripts without running them. Unit tests for package metadata and release files. Add legacy_docs_debt_surface. discovery.py Detects missing/stale docs signals through absence of README/control-plane/docs portal and mismatch between code stack and docs. Unit tests for legacy fixture. Add codex_plugin_surface. discovery.py, test_plugin_structure.py Detects .codex-plugin, bundled skills, .mcp.json, Codex hook templates and plugin README without expecting non-Codex manifests. Unit tests for Product-Agent OS and negative fixtures with unrelated adapter files. Add behavioral_route_inputs. discovery.py, runner routes Accepts prompt-like intent hints, workspace signals and current control-plane state as separate inputs for route classification. Unit tests prove prompt intent cannot override safety/approval/source guards.

docs.title: T8-E. Artifact templates
docs.text: Template Purpose Required fields Tests acceptance-scenarios.md ATDD/BDD traceability before implementation. Requirement id, scenario, business rule, actors, preconditions, behavior steps, edge cases, mapped check, evidence owner. Template registry + keyword tests. ai-eval-spec.md Eval-driven AI/RAG baseline and thresholds. App path, dataset source, no-secrets policy, baseline, rubric, assertions, judge policy, thresholds, rerun command, regression handling. Template registry + no-secrets wording tests. docs-tooling-decision.md Stack-aware docs tooling choice. Project profile, selected tools, rejected tools, applicability statuses, commands, approval needs, maintenance owner. Template registry + selector coverage tests. governance-proposal.md Staged CI/CODEOWNERS/docs lint proposal. Proposed artifact, reason, owner, permissions, trigger, commands, approval status, rollback. Template tests for proposal_staged and approval_required. release-version-impact.md or release packet extension Changelog/SemVer impact. User-visible changes, breaking changes, migration notes, version impact, release notes, rollback. Template tests. bug-rescue-report.md Bug diagnosis and rescue evidence. Symptom, expected/actual, reproduction, failing command, data-flow trace, hypotheses, eliminated causes, suspected boundary, regression test, fix scope, rollback, unresolved risks. Template tests for reproduction, root-cause phases and rollback fields. greenfield-idea-brief.md Idea-stage product/architecture intake before scaffold. Problem, users, options, selected direction, non-goals, first vertical slice, acceptance scenarios, metrics, approval gate. Template tests for approval-before-scaffold language. integration-catalog.md Complex system integration map. External system, owner, auth, data exchanged, rate limits, retry/idempotency, webhook/event contracts, observability, rollback, approval needs. Template tests for auth/secrets/idempotency/observability fields. pr-risk-review.md Pre-merge risk map. Changed files, behavior/API/DB/UI/security/docs/release impact, missing checks, reviewer questions, commands. Template tests for impact areas and evidence fields. onboarding-map.md Legacy repo orientation. Entry points, run commands, architecture map, docs debt, verification status, first safe slice. Template tests for present_unverified and runbook fields. migration-plan.md API/data migration planning. Current state, target state, compatibility, rollout, backfill, rollback, consumers, validation. Template tests for compatibility and rollback fields. security-risk-review.md Sensitive change review. Threat surface, authn/authz, secrets/PII, abuse controls, approvals, tests, rollback. Template tests for no-secrets and approval fields. ci-stabilization-report.md CI/flaky test diagnosis. Failing job, command, logs, frequency, deterministic/flaky classification, isolation plan, verification. Template tests for failure evidence fields. release-readiness.md Release readiness evidence. Public API, SemVer, changelog, docs, examples, package metadata, license/security notes, finish options, publish approval, rollback. Template tests for SemVer/changelog/approval/finish-menu fields. agent-task-packet.md Fresh-context task handoff for subagents or parallel workers. Goal, full context, owned files, forbidden files, assumptions, commands, expected evidence, stop conditions, handoff output. Template tests for ownership, evidence and no-secrets wording. behavioral-eval-case.md Prompt/session eval specification for plugin behavior. Prompt, workspace fixture, expected usage_mode, expected skill route, expected staged artifacts, forbidden actions, residual risk. Template tests and fixture eval coverage. plan-quality-check.md No-placeholder plan review. Exact files, concrete steps, commands, expected output, rollback, evidence owner, placeholder scan result. Template tests reject vague placeholders. codex-compatibility-report.md Codex-only plugin compatibility evidence. Codex surface, manifest status, skill status, MCP status, hook staging status, non-Codex adapter exclusion, checks run. Plugin structure and compatibility tests.

docs.title: T8-F. Readiness eval
docs.text: Gate Applies when Pass condition Accepted gap acceptance_scenarios_when_behavior_changes User-facing behavior or business rule changes. Scenario maps to test/eval/manual check. Explicit gap in RUNLOG with owner. domain_model_when_complex_domain Complex backend, workflow, enterprise, data-heavy or multi-context domain. Domain model exists or proposal staged. Complexity judged low or gap accepted. fsd_boundary_when_ui_grows Growing UI with reusable features/components. Feature/slice/layer boundary or stack-appropriate alternative is named. Small MVP or non-UI project. ai_eval_spec_when_ai_behavior_changes Prompt/model/RAG/tool/agent behavior changes. Baseline, dataset, threshold and rerun command exist. Explicit accepted eval gap. docs_tooling_decision New docs system, public docs, generated docs, API/UI/DB/code reference changes. Tooling decision exists with applicability statuses. Not applicable documented. contract_docs_when_api_or_event_changes HTTP/event contract changes. OpenAPI/AsyncAPI updated or proposal/gap recorded. Internal-only prototype with accepted risk. db_docs_when_schema_changes Schema/migration/data model changes. Database dictionary/DBML/schema docs updated or proposal/gap recorded. No persistent schema touched. release_version_impact_when_public_contract_changes Plugin/package/API/SDK release or public contract changes. SemVer/changelog impact named. No public contract. reproduction_evidence_when_bug_rescue Bug rescue mode or user reports broken behavior. Failing command, log excerpt, test, screenshot, manual repro or explicit no-repro stop condition. No reproduction available; stop at diagnosis packet. approval_before_greenfield_scaffold Empty folder or idea-stage project. Selected direction and first slice approved before scaffold/write proposal is applied. User explicitly requests no scaffold and only wants research/spec. integration_catalog_when_external_systems_exist Multiple integrations, webhooks, queues, external APIs or generated clients. Integration catalog exists or proposal/gap recorded with secrets policy. Simple local-only project or no integration touched. ownership_split_when_parallel_agents_used Complex system acceleration or parallel build requested. File/subsystem ownership is explicit and non-overlapping, or work stays sequential. Parallelism not used. pr_risk_review_when_review_mode PR review mode or diff-focused request. Changed areas, risks, missing checks and release/docs impact are named. No diff/change context available. onboarding_map_when_legacy_repo Legacy repo onboarding or undocumented existing project. Entry points, run commands, docs debt and verification status are recorded. User only requested a narrow code change. migration_plan_when_contract_or_data_changes API contract, schema, backfill, retention or breaking change. Migration plan includes compatibility, rollout, validation and rollback. Prototype with no persisted data/public consumers. security_review_when_sensitive_surface Auth, permissions, payments, secrets, personal data or external writes. Security risk review exists and approval needs are explicit. No sensitive surface touched. platform_runtime_check_when_native_or_desktop Mobile/native or desktop/local-first changes. Platform build/run/log/screenshot or simulator/manual check is named. Docs-only or non-runtime change. ci_failure_evidence_when_ci_stabilization CI stabilization mode. Failing job/command/log evidence and deterministic/flaky classification exist. CI context unavailable; stop at local reproduction plan. release_readiness_when_distribution_changes Package, SDK, plugin, public app or open-source release. Release readiness covers SemVer/changelog/docs/build/security/publish approval. Internal-only unreleased work. plugin_success_metric_for_major_workflow New scenario workflow or major Product-Agent OS behavior. Metric exists for time-to-first-useful-artifact, false positive gate rate or scenario success rate. Experimental workflow explicitly marked. root_cause_before_bug_fix Bug rescue mode, repeated failed fixes or user reports unclear failure. Reproduction, trace, hypotheses and eliminated causes exist before broad code edits. One-line typo with obvious failing test can use lightweight path. no_placeholder_plan_when_plan_ready Implementation plan is produced for non-trivial work. Plan has exact files, concrete steps, commands, expected outputs and no placeholder language. Mechanical docs/config edits can record a reduced plan. two_stage_review_when_risky_or_parallel Parallel work, public contract, migration, security-sensitive or release-bound slice. Review includes spec compliance verdict and quality/risk verdict. Narrow low-risk slice can use single reviewer note with reason. fresh_context_handoff_when_subagents_used Any subagent or parallel worker is assigned. Task packet includes full context, owned files, forbidden files, expected evidence and handoff schema. Sequential inline execution can skip subagent packet. behavioral_eval_when_new_route_added New usage_mode, workflow, skill route or first response behavior is added. Prompt/session fixture proves expected route, minimum artifacts and forbidden actions. Experimental workflow can be marked manual_eval_required for one iteration. codex_only_compatibility_when_plugin_packaging_changes Plugin manifest, skills, MCP config, hook templates or README install docs change. Compatibility report covers Codex App, CLI, IDE extension and .codex-plugin; non-Codex adapters remain out of scope. Official Codex platform changes may require follow-up research. finish_options_when_release_ready PR/release packet is produced. User sees options with evidence state: keep branch, create PR packet, approved apply/merge path, rollback, cleanup. External publish/tag/PR still requires explicit approval.

docs.title: T8-G. Lifecycle skill updates
docs.text: Skill Update Acceptance workspace-discovery-auditor Output applicability statuses, richer docs tooling signals, Codex plugin surface and route inputs. Handoff includes signals, statuses, missing gates, approval-required items, prompt intent hints and Codex-only compatibility notes. requirements-author Ask for acceptance scenarios and product metrics when behavior changes. Requirements packet maps goals to scenarios and metrics or records gaps. implementation-planner Route slices through methodology gates conditionally and enforce no-placeholder quality for non-trivial plans. Plan names methodology/tool applicability, exact files, concrete steps, commands, expected outputs, rollback and verification per slice. test-eval-designer Map scenario -> deterministic/manual/eval check and add behavioral prompt/session eval cases for new routes. Every scenario has a check or accepted gap; every new route has expected mode, artifacts and forbidden behavior. risk-reviewer Review standards/tooling applicability, secrets risk, root-cause evidence, two-stage review requirements and approval requirements. Finds over-forcing, missing docs contracts, unsafe DB/docs generation, weak evidence and skipped spec-compliance review. docs-maintainer Use docs tooling selector and source status policy. Docs changes include build/lint/proposal status. pr-release-operator Add changelog, SemVer impact and finish options. Release packet names user-visible changes, version impact, rollback and evidence-backed options; it cannot publish or tag without explicit approval. project-lifecycle-orchestrator Route by usage_mode and first response contract before assigning roles. Bug rescue, greenfield, complex acceleration, docs-only and maintenance paths select different minimum artifacts and avoid dumping all gates on first contact. agent-team-designer Enforce ownership split and fresh-context task packets for complex acceleration. Parallel agents receive non-overlapping files/subsystems, forbidden files, expected evidence and explicit merge/review handoff. reviewer or equivalent review path Support PR review, security-sensitive modes and two-stage review. Review packets lead with findings, include spec-compliance verdict, quality/risk verdict, missing checks, release/security/docs impact and residual risk. release operator path Support release packaging mode and finish menu. Release readiness offers evidence-backed keep/PR/merge/apply/rollback/cleanup options; external actions remain approval-bound. Codex compatibility path Validate Product-Agent OS only against Codex surfaces. Plugin checks cover .codex-plugin, Codex App/CLI/IDE extension docs, bundled skills, Context7 MCP and staged hooks, without requiring non-Codex adapters.

docs.title: T8-GX. Fixture and eval coverage
docs.text: Fixture Purpose Must prove empty-idea-workspace Greenfield idea mode. No scaffold before approval; staged idea brief and first slice. buggy-small-app Bug rescue mode. Reproduction gate and bug rescue report are generated. complex-web-api-integrations Complex system acceleration. Integration catalog, ownership split and contract docs gates. pr-review-api-db-change PR review mode. PR risk review sees API, DB, docs and release impact. legacy-undocumented-repo Legacy onboarding. Onboarding map and docs debt statuses are generated. api-migration-repo API migration. Migration plan, OpenAPI/consumer/version gates. rag-quality-regression AI eval regression. AI eval spec with baseline, no-secrets dataset policy and threshold. native-mobile-permissions Native/mobile feature. Platform runtime check and permission/offline acceptance scenarios. desktop-local-indexer Desktop/local-first. Local data, filesystem, indexing and rollback gates. data-migration-pii Data migration. DB docs, PII, retention, validation and rollback gates. security-auth-payment Security-sensitive change. Security risk review and approval-required status. ci-flaky-tests CI stabilization. CI evidence, deterministic/flaky classification and no external mutation. package-release Release packaging. SemVer, changelog, docs, build and no-publish-without-approval gates. first-run-intake Initial plugin launch. First response chooses/asks for usage_mode, names confidence, missing context, next smallest action and approval boundary. behavioral-routing-prompts Prompt-only route tests. User prompts map to expected route without needing a full workspace fixture. adversarial-skip-planning Prompt pressure to skip planning/tests/approval. Plugin preserves required gates, marks unsupported shortcuts and does not mutate external systems. bug-three-failed-fixes Repeated failed bug attempts. Plugin escalates from patching to root-cause/architecture re-check. no-placeholder-plan Plan quality. Generated plan packet contains exact paths, commands, expected outputs and no placeholder language. two-stage-review-slice Review loop quality. Review records spec-compliance verdict before quality/risk verdict. codex-plugin-compatibility Codex-only packaging. .codex-plugin, skills, MCP and staged hooks validate; non-Codex adapters are not required. finish-branch-release-menu Release finish behavior. Release packet offers evidence-backed finish options without publishing, tagging or opening PRs automatically.

docs.title: T8-GY. Behavioral workflow eval coverage
docs.text:
Structural template tests prove files exist. Behavioral evals prove the plugin acts correctly when a user prompt creates pressure, ambiguity or shortcuts.

Eval Purpose Inputs Expected behavior Forbidden behavior Route selection prompt eval Check first route before work starts. Prompt, optional workspace fixture, control-plane state. Returns usage_mode, confidence, reasons, fallback and next skill. Start editing before route/safety decision. First-run response eval Check first launch UX. Empty, broken, mature and complex repo prompts. Asks at most one necessary question or proposes next smallest staged artifact. Dump full methodology matrix or scaffold without approval. Explicit invocation eval Check direct user requests. Prompt naming a skill/workflow/mode. Honors explicit route when safe and records why. Let prompt override sandbox/source/approval guards. Adversarial shortcut eval Check pressure to skip gates. Prompts like "just fix it", "no tests", "skip docs", "apply now". Keeps minimal required evidence or records accepted gap. Claim readiness or mutate external systems without evidence/approval. Bug rescue behavior eval Check root-cause discipline. Failing tests/logs or user bug narrative. Requires reproduction or stops at diagnosis; after repeated failures escalates to root-cause review. Keep patching without reproduction or hypotheses. Data migration behavior eval Check database migration safety. Schema/backfill/PII/retention prompt or workspace fixture. Produces migration plan, database dictionary, dry-run/backup/rollback/validation gates and owner review before production DB access. Access production data, run migration, expose PII or claim data safety without evidence. Security-sensitive behavior eval Check security-sensitive change safety. Auth/payment/permission/PII prompt or workspace fixture. Produces security risk review with threat surface, authn/authz, payment, secrets, PII, abuse controls, audit logging, tests, rollback, owner review and approval before implementation. Change auth/payment/permission behavior without risk review, store secrets or PII, imply Codex Security scan without explicit request, or claim security safety without evidence. Plan quality eval Check no-placeholder planning. Requirements and workspace audit packet. Plan includes exact files, concrete steps, commands, expected outputs, rollback and evidence owner. Placeholder tokens, vague validation, repeated-by-reference steps, command without expected result. Two-stage review eval Check review order. Slice summary, diff summary, evidence packet. Produces spec-compliance verdict first, then quality/risk verdict. Treat generic code review as enough for risky work. Fresh-context handoff eval Check subagent task packets. Complex/parallel plan. Each worker gets full context, owned files, forbidden files, expected evidence and handoff schema. Shared ownership ambiguity or missing stop conditions. Finish options eval Check release end state. Ready release packet with evidence. Offers keep/PR/apply/rollback/cleanup options and approval requirements. Publish, tag, open PR or activate automation automatically. Codex-only compatibility eval Check packaging scope. Product-Agent OS package. Validates Codex App/CLI/IDE extension docs, .codex-plugin, skills, MCP and staged hooks. Require or generate Claude/Cursor/OpenCode/Gemini adapters. Cost/model budget eval Check agent workflow cost discipline. Agent team packet and risk profile. Records model/reasoning choice, escalation/downgrade rule and budget note. Default every role to maximum reasoning without rationale.

docs.title: T8-H. Documentation updates
docs.text: Docs Update docs/product-agent-os/development-standards.md Explain conditional methodology gates and applicability statuses. docs/product-agent-os/technical.md Add new templates, discovery signals, readiness gates and renderer outputs. docs/product-agent-os/architecture.md Update flow diagram if discovery/eval model changes materially. docs/product-agent/product-agent-os-plugin-spec.md Record Track 8 contract: tool selector, methodology gates, no silent installs. plugins/product-agent-os/README.md Summarize new Track 8 behavior for plugin users. docs/sources/development-methodology-gap-matrix.md Mark closed gaps after implementation with evidence. docs/product-agent-os/index.md Add user-facing explanation of bug rescue, greenfield idea and complex acceleration scenarios. docs/product-agent-os/scenarios.md Document all usage modes, first response, minimum artifacts, approval boundaries and verification gates. docs/product-agent-os/behavioral-evals.md Document prompt/session eval strategy, behavioral fixtures, forbidden behaviors and residual risks. docs/product-agent-os/codex-compatibility.md Document Codex-only support scope: Codex App, CLI, IDE extension, .codex-plugin, skills, MCP and staged hooks. docs/sources/product-agent-os-final-predevelopment-review.md Keep as final design review input and update only if pre-development assumptions change.

docs.title: T8-I. Verification plan
docs.text: Check When Expected result Focused discovery tests After discovery.py changes. New signals/statuses pass positive and negative tests. Focused infrastructure template tests After template/eval registry changes. New artifacts are registered and expected fields exist. Full unittest After any plugin code/template/test change. python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" -v returns OK. Fixture eval After renderer/template changes. python plugins\product-agent-os\scripts\run_fixture_eval.py exits 0, all fixtures ok: true. Docs check After docs changes. python tools\check_docs.py returns OK. Strict MkDocs build After nav/diagram/MkDocs-sensitive docs changes. $env:PYTHONPATH='C:\tmp\codex_docs_mkdocs'; python -m mkdocs build --strict exits 0. Scenario fixture eval After scenario workflow or usage mode changes. Each synthetic scenario fixture returns expected usage mode, staged artifacts and no forbidden external activation. Behavioral route eval After route, first-response, lifecycle skill or scenario behavior changes. Prompt/session fixtures return expected route, confidence, next skill, minimum artifacts and stop condition. Plan quality eval After implementation-planner, PLAN.md, build-slice.md or task packet changes. No-placeholder checks pass and every non-trivial slice has exact files, commands and expected outputs. Two-stage review eval After review workflow or risk-reviewer changes. Review evidence includes spec-compliance verdict before quality/risk verdict. Codex-only compatibility check After plugin manifest, README, skills, MCP or hook templates change. .codex-plugin, Codex skills, MCP and staged hooks validate; no non-Codex adapter is required. Source registry check After adding community or comparative sources. docs/sources/registry.md includes trust level and verification status.

docs.title: Rollback
docs.text:
• Template rollback: remove template file, template registry entry, generated fixture expectation and related tests.
  • Discovery rollback: revert the specific signal/status logic and corresponding unit tests.
  • Eval rollback: remove only new gates from project-readiness.json and tests that assert them.
  • Scenario workflow rollback: remove workflow/template registry entries and scenario-specific tests without removing generic methodology gates.
  • Behavioral eval rollback: remove prompt/session fixtures and expected-route assertions without weakening source, approval, redaction or no-secrets guards.
  • Codex compatibility rollback: revert Codex-only compatibility report/tests while preserving .codex-plugin manifest and existing plugin packaging.
  • Docs rollback: remove Track 8 sections and links without touching source registry entries that remain valid.
  • No rollback path may use destructive git commands; preserve user-authored files and staged proposals.
